jobs.description:
The Company

InvestX launched in 2014 and is a late-stage venture fund investing out of Fund 5. With over US$700 million in investments and 35+ portfolio companies including Palantir, Anthropic, SpaceX, Airbnb, SoFi, Spotify, DocuSign, and many more, we work with leading North American wealth management firms and family office clients to offer multi-position and single-purpose funds.

InvestX is backed by leading financial institutions including Jefferies, Virtu Financial, and Canaccord Genuity and has been featured in CNBC, Forbes, Bloomberg, U.S. News, Business Insider, Reuters, The Globe and Mail, and other leading publications.

About the Role

We are looking for a driven, high-energy National Accounts, Associate to support the growth of InvestX's U.S. Broker Dealer distribution channel. This is a prospecting-heavy sales role for someone who enjoys opening doors, making cold calls, finding the right decision-makers, and turning new conversations into qualified opportunities.

Working closely with the National Accounts Lead, you will be responsible for building the top of the sales funnel across Broker Dealers and other wealth management firms throughout the U.S. You will research target firms, identify key contacts, execute outbound prospecting campaigns, secure meetings, and help move opportunities through the National Accounts pipeline and approval process.

We're looking for a true hunter mentality: someone persistent, competitive, resourceful, comfortable hearing "no," and motivated by creating opportunities where relationships don't already exist.

Location: United States (Remote) or Hybrid (3-days in office) New York

What You'll Do

Prospect & Build Pipeline

  • Conduct high-volume outbound prospecting into targeted Broker Dealers and wealth management firms across the U.S.
  • Cold call, email, and leverage LinkedIn and other prospecting tools to identify and engage prospective National Accounts.
  • Research target organizations and identify the right home office contacts, decision-makers, investment teams, due diligence professionals, and other key stakeholders.
  • Secure qualified introductory meetings for the National Accounts Lead.
  • Consistently build and maintain a strong pipeline of new opportunities.
  • Follow up persistently and creatively to turn initial outreach into active conversations.
  • Maintain accurate prospecting activity, contacts, opportunities, and next steps within Salesforce.

Support National Accounts

  • Partner closely with the National Accounts Lead to prioritize target firms and execute the broader National Accounts strategy.
  • Prepare research, meeting materials, prospect intelligence, and follow-up for prospective accounts.
  • Support opportunities from initial outreach through due diligence and platform approval.
  • Coordinate with Legal, Compliance, Operations, Marketing, and Sales throughout the approval and onboarding process.
  • Track account progress, outstanding requirements, and next steps to keep opportunities moving.
  • Support ongoing engagement with home office contacts, investment committees, due diligence teams, and other stakeholders.

Develop Market Intelligence

  • Build a strong understanding of the Broker Dealer and wealth management landscape.
  • Monitor competitor activity, platform developments, and trends in private markets and alternative investments.
  • Gather market feedback on InvestX's products, positioning, and advisor demand.
  • Identify new firms, contacts, and opportunities that should be added to the National Accounts pipeline.

What We're Looking For

  • 3–5+ years of sales, business development, wholesaling, or distribution experience within wealth management, asset management, financial services, or alternative investments.
  • Demonstrated success in outbound prospecting, cold calling, and generating qualified sales opportunities.
  • Comfortable spending a significant portion of the day actively prospecting and engaging new contacts.
  • A natural hunter who is energized by building relationships from scratch rather than solely managing established accounts.
  • Persistent and resilient—you are comfortable with rejection and know consistent follow-up is part of successful sales.
  • Strong communication skills and confidence engaging senior investment and wealth management professionals.
  • Curious and resourceful, with the ability to research organizations and find the right path into an account.
  • Highly organized with strong CRM and pipeline management discipline.
  • Self-directed and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.
  • Collaborative and comfortable supporting a senior National Accounts leader while taking ownership of your prospecting activity and results.

Nice to Have

  • Existing relationships within the Broker Dealer, RIA, or broader wealth management ecosystem.
  • Experience with private equity, private credit, venture capital, hedge funds, or alternative investment products.
  • Familiarity with Broker Dealer due diligence and platform approval processes.
  • Experience using Salesforce and sales prospecting platforms.
  • FINRA Series 7 and 63 or willingness to obtain relevant licensing.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role will be measured primarily by your ability to create qualified opportunities and expand the National Accounts pipeline, including:

  • Consistent outbound prospecting activity and new account penetration.
  • Qualified meetings generated with targeted firms.
  • Growth of the National Accounts pipeline for new Broker Dealers
  • Conversion of prospects into active due diligence and approval opportunities.
  • Progression of firms through the approval process.
  • Strong CRM discipline and consistent follow-through.
  • Contribution to new platform approvals and, ultimately, asset growth.

Salary & Benefits 

  • 2026 base salary range is $130,000 - $160,000 USD plus incentive plan and equity. 
  • Actual salaries may vary based on factors, such as skill, experience, location, and qualifications for the role.   
  • Comprehensive Health & Benefit plan.

jobs.description:
Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States. This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Kafka Platform Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)

Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $130,000–$180,000 Annually (based on experience)
Experience Required:10+ Years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary

Bright Vision Technologies is seeking a highly experienced Kafka Platform Engineer with 10+ years of experience in distributed systems, event streaming, and platform engineering, including extensive expertise with Apache Kafka and the Confluent Platform. The ideal candidate will architect, deploy, and manage enterprise-scale streaming platforms that power mission-critical, real-time data processing across the organization. This role requires deep technical expertise in Kafka internals, platform automation, security, observability, and cloud-native infrastructure, along with the ability to mentor engineering teams and define enterprise event-streaming standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architect, deploy, and manage highly available Apache Kafka and Confluent Platform environments supporting enterprise-scale event-driven applications.
  • Design Kafka cluster topology, broker configuration, partitioning strategies, replication, capacity planning, and performance optimization for high-throughput workloads.
  • Implement enterprise-grade security using SASL, SSL/mTLS, ACLs, RBAC, encryption, and authentication mechanisms.
  • Design and manage Kafka Connect, Schema Registry, Kafka Streams, ksqlDB, and event streaming pipelines for real-time data integration.
  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Ansible, or similar automation frameworks to provision and manage Kafka infrastructure.
  • Design and implement High Availability (HA), Disaster Recovery (DR), backup, failover, and cross-region replication strategies.
  • Build comprehensive monitoring, alerting, logging, and observability solutions using Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK, and Confluent monitoring tools.
  • Optimize cluster performance, troubleshoot production issues, conduct root cause analysis, and implement long-term platform improvements.
  • Support Kafka deployments on Kubernetes using Strimzi, Confluent Operator, or managed cloud services including AWS MSK, Azure Event Hubs (Kafka API), and Confluent Cloud.
  • Collaborate with application developers, data engineers, DevOps, SRE, and enterprise architects to establish event-driven architecture standards and best practices.
  • Conduct architecture reviews, establish platform governance, perform code reviews, and mentor engineers on Kafka development and operations.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline.
  • 10+ years of professional experience in distributed systems, platform engineering, or infrastructure engineering, including 5+ years of hands-on Apache Kafka or Confluent Platform experience.
  • Expert-level knowledge of Kafka internals, including partitions, replication, brokers, ISR, consumer groups, offset management, and performance tuning.
  • Extensive experience implementing Kafka security using SASL, SSL/mTLS, ACLs, RBAC, and enterprise authentication mechanisms.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Kafka Connect, Schema Registry, Kafka Streams, ksqlDB, and real-time event streaming architectures.
  • Experience implementing High Availability (HA), Disaster Recovery (DR), multi-cluster replication, and cross-region failover strategies.
  • Advanced scripting skills using Python, Bash, or Go, along with Infrastructure as Code experience using Terraform, Ansible, or similar tools.
  • Strong experience with observability platforms including Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK, and distributed tracing solutions.
  • Excellent troubleshooting, communication, documentation, stakeholder management, and technical leadership skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Confluent Certified Administrator or Confluent Certified Developer certification.
  • Experience operating Kafka on Kubernetes using Strimzi, Confluent Operator, or similar operators.
  • Hands-on experience with managed Kafka services including AWS MSK, Confluent Cloud, Azure Event Hubs (Kafka API), or Google Cloud Managed Kafka.
  • Experience with stream processing technologies such as Apache Flink, Apache Spark Structured Streaming, or Apache Beam.
  • Knowledge of data governance, schema evolution, metadata management, and data lineage for streaming platforms.

How to Apply

For immediate consideration, please send your resume to or contact us at (908) 505-3545. Learn more about Bright Vision Technologies at www.bvteck.com.

jobs.description:
OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.

The Position

We're assembling a small founding team to build something genuinely hard: high-throughput services that inspect live traffic, terminate and analyze TLS in the data path, and hold near-zero latency while doing it. This is real systems engineering — streaming, distributed, latency-obsessed — not another CRUD app behind a form.

You won't be starting cold. You inherit real infrastructure and real users, which means what you build reaches production in weeks, not years. The work is high-leverage from day one, and there's nowhere to hide — in the best way.

AI-native. Non-negotiable. You leverage AI to operate as a 10x engineer — demonstrable AI proficiency is a hard requirement, not a nice-to-have.

What You'll Own

You take a capability from a rough idea all the way to production, and then you keep it alive and healthy there — meeting its latency and reliability targets, instrumented well enough to prove it, and hardened to survive real load and real failure. You own the outcome, not the ticket. You'll lead a functional area end to end: set its technical direction, make the calls that matter, and pull other engineers along with you.

Who You Are

  • You see what needs to exist and you go build it — you spot the gap, scope it yourself, and start, instead of waiting for someone to hand you a task or a spec.
  • You lead by taking the hardest, least-defined part of the problem and making it work, and others follow because your judgment and output earn it — not because of a title.
  • You own the entire arc — design, build, ship, operate — and you treat what happens in production as your responsibility, making sure the system behaves exactly within the parameters it's supposed to, not just that it passed in staging.
  • When you hit the edge of what you know — a protocol you've never touched, a failure mode you've never seen — curiosity and sheer grit carry you across it faster than most people expect.
  • "Good enough" makes you uncomfortable; you hold a high bar for yourself and ship work you're genuinely proud to put your name on.

What You Bring

  • Proven, demonstrable proficiency using AI as a force multiplier — you already operate as a 10x engineer, orchestrating AI tools and agents to design, build, and ship far beyond what you could alone, while keeping the judgment to know what "correct" actually looks like.
  • 5–7+ years building and operating production services and front ends, with real experience owning something end to end and carrying the weight of it once it's in front of real users.
  • Hands-on experience with TLS / MITM inspection and the security-sensitive edge cases that come with sitting in the middle of live traffic.
  • A real track record of taming latency in streaming and distributed systems — you've chased down p99 tail latency and know that "fast on my machine" means nothing until it's fast in production, under load, with observability to back it up.
  • Strong command of a modern backend language (Go, Rust, or TypeScript/Node) and React/TypeScript on the front end, with a deep working grasp of HTTP, TLS, gRPC/REST, and async/streaming I/O.

You can join us on a part-time basis (10–15 hours per week) as an instructor leading live sessions and workshops, as a course author creating learning materials, or as a subject matter expert supporting curriculum development.

jobs.excerpt: Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.
jobs.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

What this opportunity involves We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for

  • 5+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard

Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Compensation

Up to $40/hr equivalent, depending on level and pace. Tasks are estimated at ~20 hours each; you set your own schedule.

🤓 TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. The curriculum is built by a team of senior authors.

This is a teaching and reviewing role. You'll be the senior technical presence students learn from week to week. You'll run group live events, give real engineering feedback on student deployment deliverables, and act as the escalation point for a team of supporting instructors who handle first-line questions. The best person for this is someone who has actually gone into client environments and carried AI deployments to production, has opinions about what a sound deployment looks like, and can tell an experienced engineer why their approach is wrong.

Your audience: Working production engineers, not career changers, with six to fifteen years in, mostly backend, with senior and staff engineers and the occasional engineering manager. They've shipped real software for years and are moving deliberately into forward-deployed AI work; some are already interviewing for FDE roles while they study. What they're missing is agentic systems and the client-facing half of delivery.

Format: Group live events, 1:1s, and workshops timed around US Eastern Time – mostly 2:00 PM to 9:00 PM ET. Estimated 15 to 25 hrs/week.

Please submit all resumes or CVs in English.

What you will do

  • Host live events focused on deploying AI systems inside a client's environment: discovery and scoping, agentic architecture, integration with enterprise systems, rollout, and adoption.
  • Run 1:1 sessions and tech mock interviews for students working through projects.
  • Review student projects against rubrics, including the client-facing side of the work: scoping decisions, demos, and how they explain a system to a non-technical stakeholder.
  • Set the technical standard for a team of supporting instructors who cover questions and first-line review, and act as their escalation point.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of professional engineering experience, currently working at senior level or above (Senior/Lead/Staff Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Architect, or technical lead on customer-facing delivery).

  • Has worked embedded within a customer team as their primary technical resource, or held a customer-facing engineering role (solutions engineer, solutions architect, technical consultant).
  • Production experience with agentic frameworks (LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI) and MCP-based tool integrations into client systems.
  • Work experience at a recognizable company.
  • Familiarity with online education platforms or running programs.

What we can offer you

  • Fully remote work, with live sessions scheduled within US afternoon and evening hours.

InvestX launched in 2014 and is a late-stage venture fund investing out of Fund 5. We are looking for a driven, high-energy Director, RIA Business Development to help expand InvestX's Registered Investment Advisor (RIA) distribution channel across the U.S.

This is a prospecting-first sales role for someone who gets energy from creating opportunities. You will spend a significant portion of your time identifying target RIAs, cold calling, executing outbound outreach, finding the right decision-makers, and turning new conversations into qualified meetings and opportunities.

Working closely with the Head of RIA Business Development, you will help build the top of the sales funnel and expand InvestX's reach within the independent wealth management market.

We're looking for a true hunter mentality. You are persistent, competitive, curious, and resourceful. You're comfortable picking up the phone, hearing "no," following up again, and finding another way into an account. You don't wait for opportunities to come to you—you create them.

  • Conduct high-volume outbound prospecting into RIAs across the U.S.

Build Relationships & Market Knowledge

  • Develop relationships with advisors and key stakeholders throughout the RIA ecosystem.
  • Build a strong understanding of the independent wealth management landscape and how RIAs evaluate private market investments.
  • Monitor competitor activity, market developments, and advisor demand.
  • Gather market feedback to help inform InvestX's sales approach, product positioning, and prospecting strategy.
  • Represent InvestX at select industry events, conferences, and advisor meetings.

What We're Looking For

  • 3–5+ years of sales, business development, wholesaling, lead generation, or distribution experience within wealth management, asset management, financial services, or alternative investments.
  • Demonstrated success with outbound prospecting, cold calling, and generating qualified sales opportunities.
  • Comfortable spending a significant portion of the day actively prospecting and speaking with new contacts.

The AI Enablement Sr. Manager will also lead the departmental AI Center of Excellence, develop custom GPTs and AI agents, manage training and champions programs, support responsible AI practices, measure adoption and impact, and partner with IT, Innovation, Legal, Risk, Brand, Marketing Operations, Sales Enablement, and business stakeholders to advance Baker Tilly Marketing’s AI roadmap.

Collaborate with Marketing, Sales, CX, Operations, IT, Innovation, HR/Learning, Legal, Risk, Brand, Information Security and platform owners to coordinate dependencies, support change management and resolve adoption barriers.

5. Measure and report AI adoption, usage, productivity and impact. Define KPIs, establish baselines and report progress, outcomes, risks and opportunities to department leadership.

jobs.title: Client Onboarding Executive - Singapore Clients - Remote
jobs.excerpt: Through proprietary software and AI, along with a focus on customer delight, Sleek makes the back-office easy for micro SMEs.
jobs.description:
Through proprietary software and AI, along with a focus on customer delight, Sleek makes the back-office easy for micro SMEs.

We give Entrepreneurs time back to focus on what they love doing - growing their business and being with customers. With a surging number of Entrepreneurs globally, we are innovating in a highly lucrative space.

We operate 3 business segments:

  1. Corporate Secretary: Automating the company incorporation, secretarial, filing, Nominee Director, mailroom and immigration processes via custom online robots and SleekSign. We are the market leaders in Singapore with ~5% market share of all new business incorporations
  2. Accounting & Bookkeeping: Redefining what it means to do Accounting, Bookkeeping, Tax and Payroll thanks to our proprietary SleekBooks ledger, AI tools and exceptional customer service
  3. FinTech payments: Overcoming a key challenge for Entrepreneurs by offering digital banking services to new businesses

﻿

Sleek launched in 2017 and now has around 15,000 customers across our offices in Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia and the UK. We have around 500 staff with an intact startup mindset.

﻿

We have recently raised Series B financing off the back of >70% compound annual growth in Revenue over the last 5 years. Sleek has been recognised by The Financial Times, The Straits Times, Forbes and LinkedIn as one of the fastest growing companies in Asia.

﻿

Backed by world-class investors, we are on track to be one of the few cash flow positive, tech-enabled unicorns based out of Asia-Pacific.

Requirements

We are looking for a detail-oriented Client Onboarding Executive to champion speed, accuracy, and compliance in the first critical stage of our clients' journey.

Based in the Philippines, you will work independently in a remote environment, driven by a passion for understanding business owners. You are proactive and committed to delivering world-class service to our clients. In this role, you will expand your technical expertise while collaborating with diverse businesses across multiple industries.

Mission

The Client Onboarding Executive ensures a smooth and fast onboarding experience for every new Sleek client. By understanding Singapore’s regulatory requirements and using AI-driven workflows, you will maintain high data accuracy and compliance. Your goal is to quickly turn new sign-ups into fully live entities with speed, precision, and a great client experience.

Outcomes

Client Journey & Service Delivery

  • End-to-End Onboarding: Own the client onboarding journey, ensuring a tailored and delightful experience that secures long-term retention.
  • Accuracy & Quality: Maintain 100% accuracy in client billings, statutory filings, and adherence to Sleek’s Terms & Conditions.
  • The "Three-Day" Vision: Execute workflows with speed and precision, relentlessly pursuing the goal of less than three business days of "Sleek Time" for client processing. Proactively inform clients in case of roadblocks or any further information needed.
  • Focus on Tangible KPIs: Maintain high CSAT and aim for lowest time to onboard.

Operational Excellence & Compliance

  • Regulatory Mastery: Apply expertise in ACRA regulations, the Companies Act 1967, and AML/CFT policies to ensure every client is onboarded with absolute compliance.
  • Workflow Efficiency: Organise daily tasks effectively to ensure all deliverables align with scope and tight timelines while maintaining strict client confidentiality. Follow SOP and onboarding processes
  • AI-Augmented Execution: Utilise Sleek’s automation and AI tools to streamline manual tasks, transitioning toward a 100% efficient, system-driven workflow.

Collaboration & Growth

  • Continuous Evolution: Participate in a "continuous improvement" loop by providing feedback to management to help refine and simplify processes every month.
  • Stakeholder Support: Collaborate with the Head of Client Onboarding and Team Leader to implement the Sleek Strategic Roadmap and scalable workflows.
  • Problem Solving: Act as a primary point of contact for client queries, resolving requests with precision and escalating complex matters when necessary.
  • Collaboration: Collaborate with Compliance, Corporate Secretary, and Sales to deliver the best experience to the client.

To do this, you will have:

  • Education: Recognised degree or diploma in Business Administration or equivalent.
  • Experience: Ideally experience in client-facing roles, handling sensitive information and complex client matters.
  • Technical Skills: Hands-on experience with Google Workspace, Microsoft applications, and various productivity software.
  • Compliance Knowledge: A good understanding of Singapore regulatory compliance (ACRA, AML/CFT) is highly preferred.
  • Mindset: Self-motivated, proactive, and highly organised with a "detail-oriented" approach.
  • Adaptability: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, technology-driven, and VUCA environment.
  • Communication: Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to effectively support entrepreneurs.

Behavioural fit is also important at Sleek, and we will be looking for candidates that have a proven track record of embodying the below attributes in their recent roles:

Ownership: This shows reliability and helps build trust within the team. We move fast and need to know that everyone will see things through to completion and proactively help to get things back on track when challenges arise. Accountability is really important to us.

Humility: There is so much we don’t know. Humility allows for open-mindedness to feedback and a willingness to learn from others. It paves the way for collaboration and creates a positive work environment. It is a key ingredient of self awareness and emotional intelligence.

Structured Thinking: Our business is complex with many layers (many services, many countries, many cultures). Regardless of whether you’re more analytical or creative in nature, being able to show sound judgement is important to us. It ensures solutions are pragmatic and balance the needs of the organisation, team and customers.

Data driven: We are a data rich business with ~15,000 small customers. Each decision we make can impact many more people than we realise - so it’s critical that we use sound data to support our strategies and review the success of our initiatives.

Can have tough conversations in a positive way: It’s not a matter of if, but when difficult interpersonal situations arise. Disagreement, conflict and disappointment are a given in a fast moving business where people care about their work. People that proactively have tough conversations with kindness build empathy, trust and great working relationships.

The interview process

The successful candidate will participate in the below interview stages. We anticipate the process to last no more than 3 weeks from start to finish.

Whether the interviews are held over video call or in person will depend on your location and the role.

One-Way Video Interview/ TA Screen

The first step in our process is either a One-Way Video Interview or a meeting with our Talent Acquisition team.Both formats are designed to explore your professional background and align on your expectations for the role.

Technical Round

A ~60 minute chat with the Hiring Manager. They’ll discuss your last 1-2 roles to understand your experience in more detail.

Soft Skills Assessment

A ~45 minute chat with a leadership team, where they will dive into some of your recent work situations to understand how you think and work.

Offer + reference interviews

We’ll make a non-binding offer verbally or over email, followed by a couple of short phone or video calls with references that you provide to us.

+++++

Requirement for background screening

Please be aware that Sleek is a regulated entity and as such is required to perform different levels of background checks on staff depending on their role.

This may include using external vendors to verify the below:

  • Your education
  • Any criminal history
  • Any political exposure
  • Any bankruptcy or adverse credit history

We will ask for your consent before conducting these checks. Depending on your role at Sleek, an adverse result on one of these checks may prohibit you from passing probation.

By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Data Privacy Statement for Candidates, found at sleek.com.

Benefits

Some other great things about working at Sleek…

Humility and kindness: Humility is a core attribute we hire for, which means we have a culture of not taking ourselves too seriously and being able to laugh. Kindness is also incredibly important. We are committed to creating and nurturing a diverse and inclusive environment.

Flexibility: You’ll be able to work from home 5 days per week. If you need to start early or start late to cater to your family or other needs, we don’t mind, so long as you get your work done and proactively communicate. You can also work fully remote from anywhere in the world for 1 month each year

Financial benefits: We pay competitive market salaries and provide staff with generous paid time off and holiday schedules. Certain staff at Sleek are also eligible for our employee share ownership plan and can share in the upside of our stellar growth trajectory as we work toward listing on a prominent stock exchange in the Asia Pacific region.

Personal growth: You’ll get a lot of responsibility and autonomy at Sleek - we move at a fast pace so you’ll be making decisions, making mistakes and learning. There’s also a range of internal and external facing training programmes we run. We’re also at the forefront of utilising AI in our space and are developing a regional centre of AI excellence. It is our intention that if you leave Sleek, you leave as a more well-rounded person and professional.

Sleek is also a proudly certified B Corp. Since we started our journey in 2017, we’ve been committed to building Sleek as a force for good. In just over 5 years, we’ve joined a community of industry leaders like Patagonia, Ben & Jerry's, and P&G who are building an inclusive, equitable, and a regenerative economy.

Who We Are:

We are a tech-enabled growth firm–at the intersection of marketing, consulting & data intelligence–igniting revenue and brand recognition for leading and emerging companies around the world. As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. Our vision is to be recognized as the most valued and respected private growth marketing firm in the world–with a scalable brand, culture and services. Our mission is to power the relentless pursuit of growth and redefine what’s possible through a team of growth-obsessed experts who demand innovation and results - driven by integrity, autonomy, and grit.

As a full-service growth marketing firm, we offer best-in-class services including: SEO, Content Marketing, Paid Media, Social Media Marketing, Programmatic + CTV, Public Relations, Influencer Marketing, Email + SMS, Conversion Rate Optimization, Retail Marketing, and Creative. Here at Power Digital, we are hyper-focused on helping brands drive revenue growth and brand recognition, ultimately driving irrefutable value for our clients.

At the heart of Power Digital is our proprietary technology, nova, which analyzes businesses through first-party data, simplifying investment planning for marketing and diligence in M&A––putting marketers in a strategic seat at the table––and providing value in unparalleled ways.

Managing billions in media, our dynamic team––of consultative marketers, creatives, analysts and technologists––challenge traditional ways of planning and measurement through meticulous testing and data science across each milestone of the customer journey.

***Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

A day in the life:

Power Digital Marketing is looking for a Programmatic Media Manager who will be responsible for driving performance, strategy, and account growth for major multi-channel paid media clients. The Programmatic Media Manager will report directly to the Programmatic Supervisor, who will help guide strategy, vendor, and client relationships that will guide the media execution for this role. The Programmatic Media Manager will support media strategy and planning and be responsible for execution, analysis, reporting, and communicating updates with the team.

The Programmatic Media Manager should have strong media management skills and be able to lead as the subject matter expert in internal meetings and with ad platform partners, while contributing in client meetings. You will have experience deploying paid media strategies across multiple channels, guiding an internal team towards successfully driving business growth for clients, and confidently defending critical elements of the work.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Successful management of designated paid media accounts
  • Meet pacing and KPI requirements for held accounts based on set goals and improved performance expectations.
  • Work with Account Managers and the Media Supervisor to identify client goals, priorities and efficiency requirements.
  • Work with Account Managers & the Media Supervisor to identify client goals, priorities & efficiency requirements, ultimately improving Paid Media’s contribution to business success.
  • Actively works to increase billing & channel support for existing media accounts & propose opportunities to expand media coverage for new accounts.
  • Continually work to learn new strategies, test new platforms & expand Cardinal’s paid media offerings.
  • Function as the primary point of contact both internally & externally for all ‘owned’ accounts, responsible for pacing & performance of accounts.
  • Responsible for generating reports, writing insights & communicating with the client for designated accounts.
  • Responsible for the ongoing maintenance of held accounts, including but not limited to optimizations, structural updates, bidding methodologies, conversion types, and copy revisions.
  • Contribution to Paid Media strategy for assigned accounts, working with the Media Supervisor as needed.
  • Responsible for strategic ideation on all accounts, designing & adjusting campaign strategies to meet each client’s business goals (and internal objectives).
  • Responsible for designing & deploying tests in accounts on a monthly & quarterly cadence (structural, targeting, creative & messaging, conversion, etc).
  • Responsible for continual testing, verification & improvement of full-funnel structures.

Role Requirements:

  • 2-5+ years of Paid Media experience
  • Experience managing multiple paid media accounts with budgets ranging between $200K-$1MM.per month.
  • Extensive experience in campaign management & strategy across programmatic ad platforms, including DSPs ( Viant, StackAdapt, Cadent, Illumin, The Trade Desk, DV360, etc.), DMPs, and other data and ad tech partners.
  • Experience directly managing campaigns, as well as working with partners via managed service.
  • Experience in campaign management & strategy across additional platforms is a plus, but not required (Google Ads, Bing Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, etc.)

jobs.description:
The Life and Critical Illness Underwriting Co-Signer is a critical role within Manulife’s underwriting organization, responsible for delivering high-quality, competitive underwriting decisions while actively developing the next generation of underwriting talent. This role supports Manulife’s underwriting philosophy by partnering with underwriters on complex and high-value files, strengthening decision quality, and ensuring sound risk management practices are consistently applied.

In addition to co-signing decisions, the Underwriting Co-Signer plays an important role in training, coaching, and shaping future-ready underwriting capabilities. The individual will help underwriters build confidence, critical thinking, judgment, and business awareness in an environment where digital tools, AI-enabled insights, and evolving customer expectations are changing how underwriting work is performed. Through active mentorship, file review, feedback, and collaboration, this role helps create a stronger underwriting pipeline and supports the future of underwriting at Manulife.

Key Responsibilities

  • Underwriting Decisions: Evaluate and make underwriting decisions on life and critical illness insurance applications with approval limits up to $10 million, ensuring decisions align with Manulife’s underwriting philosophy, risk appetite, and regulatory expectations.

  • Co-Signing and File Review: Partner with assigned underwriters to review complex, high-value, or development-focused files, assessing the underwriting approach, evidence ordered, documentation, decision rationale, and customer/advisor impact.

  • Training and Development: Actively train, coach, and mentor underwriters to build technical expertise, critical thinking, decision confidence, and readiness for increased approval limits and broader underwriting responsibilities.

  • Future of Underwriting Capability Building: Support the development of future-ready underwriting skills, including effective use of digital tools, AI-enabled decision support, data-driven insights, and continuous improvement practices.

  • Decision Quality and Consistency: Promote consistent application of underwriting guidelines, Manulife’s philosophy, financial and medical underwriting principles, and appropriate risk management practices.

  • Business and Customer Impact: Help underwriters understand the broader business impact of their decisions, including requirement ordering, amendments, advisor communication, cycle time, customer experience, persistency, and competitive positioning.

  • Volume and Service Expectations: Manage co-signing and underwriting work efficiently, supporting service standards and timely decision-making while balancing quality, development, and business priorities.

  • Coaching Conversations and Feedback: Provide timely, constructive feedback through case discussions, coaching sessions, office hours, and file reviews to accelerate underwriter development and reinforce learning.

  • Collaboration: Work collaboratively with underwriting leaders, Risk Management, Research, medical directors, and new business to support consistent decisions and a seamless customer and advisor experience.

  • Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve underwriting processes, documentation, training approaches, requirement ordering, and use of tools to strengthen underwriting outcomes and future capabilities.

Qualifications

  • Experience: A minimum of 5 years of experience in life and critical illness underwriting, with a proven track record of handling complex and high-value cases.

  • Technical Expertise: Strong knowledge of life and critical illness underwriting, including medical, financial, non-medical, product, and persistency considerations.

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in finance, business, health sciences, or a related field is preferred. Professional underwriting designations or progress toward designations such as FALU, FLMI, ACS, or equivalent are highly desirable.

  • Coaching and Development: Demonstrated ability to mentor, coach, and develop underwriters through practical case review, feedback, structured learning, and knowledge sharing.

  • Critical Thinking: Strong analytical, judgment, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess risk, challenge assumptions, and apply guidelines with sound business context.

  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex decisions clearly and constructively to underwriters, leaders, advisors, and internal partners.

  • Digital Mindset: Comfort with underwriting technology, digital tools, data insights, and AI-enabled decision support, with a willingness to help others adopt new ways of working.

  • Leadership Behaviours: Ability to model collaboration, curiosity, accountability, adaptability, and a continuous improvement mindset in a fast-paced underwriting environment.

Performance Metrics

  • Decision Accuracy and Risk Management: Maintain strong underwriting decision quality, with decisions aligned to Manulife’s philosophy, guidelines, audit expectations, and risk management standards.

  • Co-Signing Quality and Consistency: Demonstrate consistent, timely, and development-focused co-signing that improves file quality, decision rationale, documentation, and underwriter independence.

  • Underwriter Development Impact: Support measurable improvement in underwriter confidence, technical capability, approval-limit readiness, decision consistency, and ability to work more independently.

  • Service and Cycle Time: Contribute to timely file review and decision-making, supporting service standards while maintaining quality and development expectations.

  • Training and Knowledge Sharing: Actively participate in case clinics, coaching sessions, office hours, and training activities that strengthen team capability and support the future of underwriting.

  • Future-Ready Capability Adoption: Encourage effective use of digital tools, AI-enabled insights, data, and process improvements to help underwriters build the skills required for a changing underwriting environment.

  • Business Impact: Support improved customer and advisor experience through better requirement ordering, clearer communication, consistent decisions, and stronger alignment between risk management and business outcomes.

jobs.description:
Copper River Cyber Solutions is seeking a highly motivated Threat Detection & Response Analyst to support the NIH cybersecurity program by monitoring enterprise systems for malicious activity, investigating security events, and responding to cybersecurity incidents. The Analyst leverages security monitoring tools, threat intelligence, and incident response procedures to identify and mitigate threats impacting NIH information systems, networks, cloud environments, and applications.

This position works closely with Incident Response personnel, Vulnerability Management Analysts, Security Engineers, RMF teams, and system owners to strengthen cybersecurity defenses and protect mission-critical systems and sensitive research data. The role contributes to continuous monitoring, threat hunting, incident investigation, and security operations activities.

Responsibilities (include but are not limited to):

  • Conduct proactive threat hunting activities using intelligence-driven and hypothesis-based methodologies.
  • Analyze threat actor tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) to identify potential compromise within NIH environments.
  • Map observed adversary behaviors, indicators, and attack patterns to the MITRE ATT&CK framework to support detection engineering, threat hunting, and risk analysis.
  • Provide threat findings, indicators, and investigations supporting RMF activities, risk assessments, POA&M development, continuous monitoring, and cybersecurity governance processes.
  • Monitor security tools, dashboards, and alerts to identify potential cybersecurity threats and suspicious activity.
  • Analyze events from endpoint, network, cloud, and security monitoring platforms.
  • Perform triage of security alerts to determine validity, severity, and potential impact.
  • Identify indicators of compromise (IOCs), attack patterns, and emerging threats.
  • Escalate significant security events in accordance with established procedures.
  • Investigate cybersecurity incidents, security events, and anomalous activity.
  • Conduct forensic review of logs, alerts, and system data to determine root cause and scope.
  • Correlate information from multiple security tools and data sources.
  • Document findings, recommendations, and lessons learned from investigations.
  • Support post-incident reviews and corrective action planning.
  • Provide threat and incident-related information supporting risk assessments and POA&M management activities.

jobs.excerpt: Who is STAT?  At STAT, we're building a people-first culture grounded in trust, transparency, and shared success.
jobs.description:
Who is STAT?

At STAT, we're building a people-first culture grounded in trust, transparency, and shared success. We're collaborative, data-driven, and never satisfied with the status quo. We evolve because our people and our customers push us to.

We are a leading, technology-enabled revenue recovery platform helping retail suppliers maximize recoveries and reduce unwarranted deductions from major retailers including Amazon, Target, and Walmart. Through proprietary software, automation, and deep industry expertise, STAT delivers industry-leading recovery rates while minimizing operational burden for customers.

Our team is the best of the best, individual contributors and leaders operating together as one. We're proud of our inclusive, positive, and collaborative culture, and we believe every team member brings something uniquely valuable to the table. We prioritize getting together in person, through functional team gatherings and by taking the time to celebrate our team members' big moments: anniversaries, birthdays, and personal wins.

About the Role

Reporting to the VP of Operations, the Business Insights Lead combines senior analyst depth with enterprise-level client experience. This role defines what data-driven insight, prevention, detection, and recovery look like for STAT's largest clients, turning transaction, deduction, and recovery data into a clear picture of where value is being lost and how to get it back.

It also carries a proactive recovery mandate: finding and pursuing dollars owed to existing clients that fall outside our normal course of business, so we close gaps against budget on the accounts we already serve. This is a builder role with strong technical fluency, blending individual analytical contributions with a client-facing, consultative presence across Protect, Recover, and Optimize.

What You’ll Do:

  • Translate complex retailer and supplier data into a clear view of hidden leakage, root causes, and recoverable value.
  • Partner with STAT's largest clients to define best-in-class data insight across prevention, detection, and recovery.
  • Build the analytical framework that flags deductions and revenue leakage earlier, surfacing actionable patterns for clients and internal teams.
  • Establish repeatable methods to validate that insights are accurate, useful, and adopted.
  • Identify recoverable dollars beyond standard audit scope on existing clients, quantifying the opportunity and pursuing it to close gaps against client budget.
  • Turn large, imperfect datasets into executive-ready insight and reporting for clients and leadership.
  • Embed insights into decisions, workflows, and client experiences—not standalone analysis.
  • Partner with audit, operations, and account teams to turn insights into recovery actions and process improvements.
  • Help shape Business Insights into a scalable capability and potential recurring-revenue offering.
  • Occasional travel required

Who You Are:

  • 5+ years in data analysis, analytics, or insights roles, ideally in retail, consumer products, or a recovery/audit environment.
  • Experience working directly with enterprise or strategic clients, comfortable presenting to senior stakeholders.
  • Strong technical fluency: SQL and/or BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, or similar) and advanced Excel, with the ability to work across structured and unstructured data.
  • A track record of translating fragmented data into measurable dollars: finding leakage, quantifying the opportunity, and driving recovery or process change.
  • Ability to translate between executive, commercial, operational, and technical audiences.

Bonus Points:

  • Working knowledge of retailer deduction, chargeback, and recovery dynamics (Walmart, Amazon, Target, and others).

Corporate Finance Manager – FP&A & Strategic Finance

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Client Business Hours

About the Role

We’re hiring a highly analytical Corporate Finance Manager to lead FP&A, financial modeling, budgeting, forecasting, executive reporting, and strategic finance for a growing U.S.-based business.

This is a high-visibility role for someone who can go beyond reporting the numbers and turn financial data into actionable business insights.

You’ll work closely with executive leadership and department heads to improve financial visibility, evaluate growth opportunities, manage planning cycles, and support strategic decision-making.

If you have strong FP&A and corporate finance experience, advanced financial modeling skills, and can confidently communicate insights to senior leadership, this role could be an excellent fit.

What You’ll Own

FP&A, Budgeting & Forecasting

  • Lead annual budgeting, quarterly forecasting, and rolling forecasts
  • Build and maintain long-range financial plans
  • Consolidate financial inputs across departments
  • Analyze actual performance against budgets and forecasts
  • Identify key drivers behind revenue, expense, margin, and profitability changes
  • Ensure financial plans align with growth and operational priorities

Financial Modeling & Strategic Analysis

  • Build and maintain financial models for:
    • Forecasting and scenario planning
    • DCF valuations
    • ROI analysis
    • IRR and NPV calculations
    • Investment opportunities
    • Pricing decisions
    • Headcount planning
    • Expansion initiatives
  • Conduct sensitivity and scenario analysis
  • Translate financial findings into clear recommendations for leadership

Executive & Board Reporting

  • Prepare monthly and quarterly financial reporting packages
  • Build KPI dashboards and management reports
  • Deliver budget-to-actual and forecast-to-actual variance analysis
  • Provide concise commentary explaining financial performance and business drivers
  • Prepare materials for executive, board, investor, and banking discussions
  • Present financial insights clearly to both financial and non-financial stakeholders

Cash Flow, Treasury & Working Capital

  • Monitor cash flow, liquidity, working capital, and burn rate
  • Maintain cash forecasting models
  • Support treasury activities and banking relationships
  • Monitor debt covenants and financing obligations
  • Identify opportunities to improve working capital and cash management

Strategic Finance & Business Partnership

  • Partner with operations, sales, product, and leadership teams
  • Support business cases and strategic initiatives with financial analysis
  • Evaluate growth opportunities and investment decisions
  • Support pricing, resource allocation, and profitability analysis
  • Help department leaders understand the financial impact of operational decisions

M&A, Investors & Corporate Development

  • Support M&A analysis and financial due diligence
  • Build acquisition and transaction models
  • Assist with valuation analysis
  • Support investor reporting and capital-raising initiatives
  • Prepare financial information and analysis for external stakeholders as needed

Finance Operations & Process Improvement

  • Improve budgeting, forecasting, and reporting processes
  • Identify opportunities for finance automation
  • Improve data accuracy and reporting efficiency
  • Support ERP and financial systems optimization
  • Mentor financial analysts or junior finance team members
  • Strengthen financial controls and planning discipline

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You combine strong financial analysis with commercial thinking
  • You can build complex models but also explain the conclusions simply
  • You understand the operational drivers behind financial performance
  • You’re comfortable presenting to executives and senior stakeholders
  • You can move between detailed analysis and high-level strategy
  • You take ownership and work effectively in fast-moving environments

Required Experience & Skills

  • 5+ years of experience in FP&A, Corporate Finance, Strategic Finance, Investment Banking, or a closely related field
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related discipline
  • Advanced financial modeling and Excel skills
  • Strong experience with:
    • Budgeting and forecasting
    • Variance analysis
    • Financial statements
    • Scenario and sensitivity analysis
    • DCF
    • IRR and NPV
    • Cash flow analysis
  • Experience with NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, or similar ERP systems
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication
  • Ability to prepare polished executive-level financial presentations
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment

Nice to Have

  • CFA, CPA, MBA, or equivalent qualification
  • M&A or transaction experience
  • Fundraising or investor relations exposure
  • Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or Looker
  • SaaS, technology, professional services, or high-growth company experience
  • Experience supporting board-level reporting
  • Finance automation or ERP optimization experience

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You may start by reviewing financial performance against the latest forecast, investigating key variances, and updating cash flow or KPI models.

Throughout the day, you could meet with department leaders to review budgets, build a scenario model for a strategic initiative, prepare an executive reporting package, or analyze the financial impact of a new investment.

You’ll regularly turn complex financial information into clear recommendations that leadership can use to make decisions.

In short: you provide the financial intelligence, planning, and strategic analysis that helps leadership allocate resources and grow the business effectively.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Accurate and reliable financial forecasts
  • Timely completion of budgeting and planning cycles
  • Strong budget-to-actual and forecast-to-actual accuracy
  • Clear visibility into cash flow and working capital
  • High-quality executive and board reporting
  • Actionable financial insights supporting business decisions
  • Improved efficiency of FP&A and reporting processes
  • Leadership confidence in financial analysis and recommendations

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application Review

  3. Financial Modeling / Strategic Analysis Exercise

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. It’s a short, self-recorded video completed on your own time and is the final step needed to complete your application.

Instead of repeating your background across multiple screening calls, you get to introduce yourself once and show hiring teams how you communicate before the first interview. If there’s a strong fit, your first live conversation can focus on the role rather than starting from scratch.

Don’t overthink it. You can record your responses multiple times, and discarded takes are not shared.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for the Spark Hire invitation.

Apply Now

If you:

  • Have strong FP&A and corporate finance experience
  • Love financial modeling and strategic analysis
  • Can turn complex financial data into clear business recommendations
  • Are comfortable working directly with senior leadership
  • Want meaningful ownership over planning, forecasting, and strategic finance

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Windchill Integration Engineer to design, build, and operate integrations connecting PTC Windchill with ERP, MES, CAD, and other engineering and manufacturing systems. In this role you will own the technical integration layer between Windchill and the broader enterprise systems landscape. The ideal candidate will bring deep hands-on Windchill integration experience and a strong understanding of enterprise integration patterns, middleware platforms, and PLM-to-ERP data flows. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

  • Design and develop integrations between Windchill and ERP systems (SAP, Oracle EBS, Oracle Cloud) using Info*Engine, web services, and middleware platforms.
  • Build CAD integrations for Creo, SolidWorks, AutoCAD, Catia, and NX with Windchill, including check-in/check-out workflows and metadata mapping.
  • Develop integrations between Windchill and MES, MOM, and quality systems.
  • Build REST and SOAP services for Windchill data using OData, Info*Engine, or custom Java services.
  • Implement message-based and event-driven integrations using middleware (MuleSoft, Boomi, OIC, SAP CPI).
  • Design and operate robust error-handling, alerting, and resubmission patterns, applying disciplined engineering practices and partnering closely with stakeholders to ensure outcomes are durable, well-documented, and aligned with broader team and platform standards.
  • Profile and optimize performance of high-volume integrations, applying systematic measurement, targeted improvements, and data-driven validation to deliver quantifiable gains in throughput, latency, or resource efficiency.
  • Lead migration efforts to retire legacy point-to-point integrations and replace them with modern, middleware-mediated patterns, planning phased cutovers, building backward-compatibility shims where needed, and ensuring each migration step is reversible and well-monitored.
  • Collaborate with PLM, ERP, and CAD functional teams to align integrations with business processes.
  • Develop integration documentation, message specifications, and runbooks, applying disciplined engineering practices and partnering closely with stakeholders to ensure outcomes are durable, well-documented, and aligned with broader team and platform standards.
  • Provide hands-on post-go-live and hypercare support, working closely with operations teams to triage incidents quickly, identify root causes, and drive durable fixes that improve long-term system stability.
  • Mentor and coach junior and mid-level engineers through code review, design review, pair programming, and structured knowledge sharing, helping the broader team grow in technical maturity and confidence over time.
  • Continuously evaluate emerging integration tools and patterns, assessing maturity, fit for purpose, and total cost of ownership, and make grounded recommendations on which to adopt, pilot, or defer based on real engineering needs.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of PLM integration experience with a strong focus on Windchill.
  • Hands-on experience with Info*Engine and Windchill Java API.
  • Experience designing PLM-to-ERP integrations (SAP, Oracle).
  • Working knowledge of CAD integration patterns.
  • Experience with middleware platforms such as MuleSoft, Boomi, OIC, or SAP CPI.
  • Strong SQL skills and familiarity with Windchill data model.
  • Experience with REST and SOAP web services.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.

That philosophy went on to shape modern operating systems, developer tooling, cloud infrastructure, and much of the software we rely on today—not because any individual tool was revolutionary, but because the platform made everyone else more productive.

We're looking for a Head of Data Engineering & Platform who can build the data platform that gives Mercury that same leverage—creating a foundation where trusted data is easy for both people and AI systems to discover, understand, and work with.

In this role, you'll lead and grow a high-performing team of data engineers responsible for Mercury's core data infrastructure. You'll shape the architecture, tooling, and engineering practices that enable reliable analytics, accelerate product development, and enable the next generation of AI-powered products and internal tools.

  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team of senior data and analytics engineers responsible for Mercury's core data infrastructure, setting a high technical bar and cultivating a strong engineering culture

  • Build a platform that makes Mercury's data easy for both people and AI systems to discover, understand, and use, investing in semantic models, metadata, and developer tooling that make trusted data reusable across the company
  • Establish the foundations for a trusted, resilient data platform by driving best practices for reliability, observability, data quality, governance, privacy, security, and regulatory compliance
  • Partner closely with Engineering, Product, Data Science, Security, and Infrastructure leaders to ensure Mercury's data platform accelerates product development, business operations, and decision-making

You should:

  • Bring 10+ years of relevant experience, including 5+ years leading data or engineering teams

  • Demonstrate the technical judgment and organizational influence to evolve data architecture through periods of rapid growth, balancing long-term, well-governed platform investments with near-term product needs
  • Bring deep expertise in modern data infrastructure, including data modeling, orchestration, streaming, storage systems, metadata, and governance

About Recast:

Recast Software, located in Minneapolis, MN, empowers organizations to better manage and support users and devices. Our mission is to simplify the work of IT teams and enable them to create highly secure and compliant environments. Our software does this by seamlessly integrating with existing IT infrastructure to quickly remediate issues, ensure compliance, enhance security, and maintain clear visibility across all devices. Recast is a rapidly growing software company with its solution being used by thousands of enterprise organizations in more than 125 countries, impacting millions of devices and (more importantly) the people who use them.

About the Role:

Recast is looking for a Product Manager II to help shape the future of Application Lifecycle Management (ALM).

You will be responsible for understanding customer needs and market opportunities that influence how organizations package, deploy, update, secure, and govern applications. You will help ensure our Application Workspace and broader ALM solutions deliver meaningful customer value and strong product-market fit.

Product Managers at Recast are accountable for defining customer problems and guiding investments that deliver meaningful customer outcomes. They partner closely with Engineering and Design throughout discovery, delivery, and post-launch learning to ensure investments create measurable customer value.

Success in this role requires regular engagement with customers and prospects to understand their challenges, validate opportunities, and identify trends that should influence product strategy. You will serve as the key connection between the North American market and the product team, helping ensure our Application Lifecycle Management investments align with real customer needs.

What You'll Do:

    Understand the Market and Customers

  • Develop deep expertise in the Application Lifecycle Management market, including customer needs, industry trends, competitive dynamics, and emerging opportunities.
  • Establish and maintain strong relationships with customers, prospects, and partners to ensure the voice of the customer informs product decisions.

    • Define Product Direction

  • Translate customer and market insights into product strategy, roadmap recommendations, and quarterly planning inputs.
  • Define customer outcomes and success metrics to prioritize investments within the Application Lifecycle Management portfolio.
  • Prioritize opportunities based on customer impact, business value, strategic alignment, and market potential.

    • Deliver Customer Outcomes

  • Partner closely with Engineering and Design within Recast’s Product Trio model to deliver solutions that create measurable customer outcomes and business value.
  • Collaborate with Product Marketing, Sales and Customer Success to align product strategy, positioning, go-to-market activities, and customer outcomes.
  • Develop a strong understanding of how customers define and measure success, using customer feedback and usage insights to improve customer value realization.

What You've Done:

  • 4+ years of experience in Product Management, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, or a similar role influencing product direction and customer outcomes.
  • Experience working directly with enterprise software customers, including gathering feedback, validating requirements, or supporting product adoption and growth.
  • Experience using customer, business, and market inputs to influence prioritization, roadmap decisions, or product strategy.

What Stands Out:

    • Demonstrated passion for understanding customers, uncovering unmet needs, and translating insights into product direction.
    • Ability to quickly develop expertise in new technical domains and become a trusted voice with customers and internal stakeholders.

What Good Looks Like:

  • You are a trusted expert in the Application Lifecycle Management market and the challenges faced by enterprise IT teams.
  • Customers, prospects, and internal teams view you as a reliable source of insight into market needs, trends, and opportunities.
  • Product decisions are informed by a consistent flow of customer feedback, discovery, and market learning rather than assumptions.
  • Roadmap investments clearly connect to customer outcomes, business value, and strategic market opportunities.
  • You help strengthen product-market fit and customer value realization across the Application Lifecycle Management portfolio.

Recast Product Management Operating Principles:

  • Customer Grounded: Decisions start with real customer problems, validated through ongoing customer conversations, support data, and win/loss input.
  • Measurable By Default: Work ships with a defined success metric. Outcomes are reviewed postlaunch, and initiatives that don’t move the needle are stopped.
  • Ownership Without Ego: Product Managers own their capabilities end to end, from discovery through delivery and measurement, and do whatever work is required to make outcomes successful.
  • AI-First Productivity: AI tools are used by default to accelerate research, synthesis, documentation, analysis, and planning so teams can focus on judgment and decision-making.

What We Value:

  • We take initiative. We have a culture of ownership and progress over perfection. We proactively drive outcomes with self-motivation and determination. We deliver results that matter for our customers and our team.
  • We get curious. Curiosity moves us forward. We ask questions, try new things, and learn from mistakes. Challenges are opportunities to explore creative solutions that benefit our customers and drive continuous improvement.
  • We work together. We appreciate the power of diverse perspectives. Through open communication, we help one another and leverage our collective expertise for better outcomes. We build trust through teamwork.
  • We embrace change. Change is inevitable; we meet it with agility and resilience. We navigate with courage and find possibility in uncertainty. We adapt for the future, shaping our path with purpose.
  • We choose empathy. We aim to deeply understand the needs of our customers and one another - it's the foundation of our relationships. We assume positive intent and practice mutual respect. We prioritize a culture of belonging because success is a shared journey.

It takes great people across an entire company to build great tools. As a growing start-up, every employee has an opportunity to make a huge impact on our business, as well as ample opportunities to learn and grow. Position Summary

The Benefit Verification Technician Team Lead is responsible for performing all Benefit Verification Technician duties while providing day-to-day leadership, workflow coordination, quality oversight, and training for the Benefit Verification team. The Team Lead serves as the department's subject matter expert, assisting leadership with daily operations, productivity monitoring, process improvements, and ensuring high-quality patient service.

Demonstrates advanced knowledge of benefit verification, specialty pharmacy operations, insurance requirements, pharmacy applications, and organizational policies and procedures. Performs all duties in accordance with regulatory requirements and organizational policies while fostering a culture of teamwork, accountability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.

Key Performance Areas

KPA 1 – Operational Leadership & Workflow Coordination

  • Coordinate daily workflow and prioritize team assignments to ensure service level expectations are achieved.
  • Monitor work queues and identify ageing orders requiring immediate attention.
  • Assist the Pharmacy Operations Supervisor with workload balancing and operational planning.
  • Serve as the first point of contact for complex benefit verification questions and escalations.
  • Communicate daily priorities, operational updates, and workflow changes to the team.
  • Identify workflow inefficiencies and recommend process improvements.
  • Lead by example while maintaining individual productivity expectations.
  • Develop and maintain workflow training materials and assist with onboarding, training, and coaching team members to ensure consistency, accuracy, and adherence to departmental processes.

KPA 2 – Data Entry, Documentation & Navigation

  • Ensure the accurate and timely documentation of patient information into multiple software systems.
  • Monitor timely creation of orders in ePrescribe and double check patient demographic information has been entered into the pharmacy software system.
  • Demonstrate advanced knowledge of EMRs and pharmacy software applications.
  • Ensure complete and accurate patient setup within pharmacy operating systems.
  • Review documentation for accuracy and completeness while coaching team members on best practices

KPA 3 – Insurance Verification

  • Verify Private, Medicaid, and Medicare insurance coverages (include VA, IHS, and other unique programs).
  • Complete patient facility (Hospital, Hospice, Rehab, ALF, Skilled Nursing, etc.) verifications and determine medication coverage.
  • Verify patient eligibility to utilize AON Pharmacy services by reviewing pharmacy insurance benefits, network participation, and claim adjudication results.
  • Refers prescriptions to our Prior Authorization or Financial Assistance teams based on claim adjudication results.
  • Identify eligible manufacturer copay assistance opportunities and coordinate referrals to the Patient Assistance Program (PAP) team for enrollment and processing.
  • Provide guidance and support to team members regarding insurance verification responsibilities, and assist the Pharmacy Operations Supervisor with workflow coordination, issue resolution, training, and daily operational oversight as needed.

KPA 4 – Specialty Pharmacy Referrals

  • Determine specialty pharmacy network participation.
  • Identify the appropriate dispensing pharmacy for specialty medications by determining network participation, limited distribution requirements, and Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS) program eligibility.
  • Oversee and coordinate referrals to external specialty pharmacies, ensuring timely processing, accurate documentation, and effective communication with patients, providers, and dispensing pharmacies.
  • Ensure timely and effective communication with patients, clinic staff, and nursing teams by utilizing appropriate documentation, EMR workflows, phone, and email communication to facilitate continuity of care and prescription processing.
  • Support the Pharmacy Operations Supervisor by reviewing external specialty pharmacy referral workflows with team members, providing guidance, and reinforcing process expectations.
  • Assist with the resolution of complex referral situations by providing guidance, troubleshooting barriers, and collaborating with internal teams, clinics, and external specialty pharmacies to ensure timely patient access to medication.

KPA 5 – Claims Resolution

  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex claim adjudication issues by interpreting payer responses, addressing coverage barriers, and providing guidance to team members as needed.
  • Obtain Limited Distribution overrides when appropriate and provide guidance to team members regarding the required processes, documentation, and workflow steps to support timely access to specialty medications.
  • Resolve coordination of benefits (COB) issues.
  • Assist team members with complex payer requirements.
  • Partner with all AON team members to resolve patient access barriers, including but not limited to Prior Authorization, Financial Assistance, Dispensing, and Clinical teams inside the pharmacy as well as clinic staff.
  • Evaluate payer-related barriers and escalate unresolved issues to leadership when appropriate, ensuring all necessary information is documented and communicated to support effective resolution.

KPA 6 – Team Development & Quality Assurance

  • Promote effective communication and exceptional customer service across all internal and external interactions by modeling professional behavior, supporting team members, and reinforcing patient-centered service expectations.
  • Demonstrate the ability to actively listen and understand patient questions and provide accurate answers and solutions. Will ensure that all phone calls are addressed professionally, courteously and in a timely manner.
  • Monitor team email communications to ensure responses are timely, professional, and aligned with departmental expectations. Work with the Pharmacy Operations Supervisor to provide coaching to team members and intervene as needed to address concerns, clarify workflows, and support effective communication.
  • Assist the Pharmacy Operations Supervisor to promote consistency and operational excellence across the team by supporting standardized workflows, coaching team members on process expectations, and assisting with quality audits and performance reviews as needed.

KPA 7 – Pharmacy Call Center Communication

  • Demonstrate exceptional customer service to patients, providers, clinics, and internal departments.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert and departmental resource for benefit verification questions, providing guidance and support to team members to promote accuracy, consistency, and timely resolution.
  • Facilitate communication between operational teams.
  • Review incoming department communications to ensure timely responses.
  • Assist leadership in resolving escalated patient or provider concerns.
  • Promote professional and respectful communication across all departments.

KPA 8 – Compliance

  • Verify all department compliance training is completed by the established deadlines.
  • Maintain continuing education requirements for licensure.
  • Maintain and ensure the confidentiality of all patient and employee information as required by the HIPAA regulations. Will assist department management in ensuring the storage, collection, and destruction of all Protected Healthcare Information is adherent to all federal and state guidelines, in addition to all accreditation standards.

Minimum Relevant Experience

As part of Workiva's Growth Solutions team, the Solution Development Consultant serves as a forward-deployed builder, applying GenAI engineering to complex reporting and regulatory challenges.
