jobs.title: Business Intelligence Lead
jobs.excerpt: Position Summary Join Penn Foster Group as we build the future of education technology.
jobs.description:
Position Summary Join Penn Foster Group as we build the future of education technology. We are embarking on an exciting enterprise platform modernization journey—transforming our data, analytics, and technology ecosystem to leverage modern cloud platforms, artificial intelligence (AI), and next-generation Business Intelligence capabilities. This is a unique opportunity to play a pivotal leadership role in shaping the future of how data drives decisions across our organization. As our Business Intelligence Lead, you will define the vision, architecture, and strategy for enterprise Business Intelligence and self-service analytics while helping modernize our analytics platform through Power BI, Tableau, SAP BusinessObjects, Databricks, and modern cloud technologies. You will establish the governance, security, engineering practices, and scalable architecture that will support the next generation of analytics and AI-enabled decision making. This role is more than leading Business Intelligence—it is about building a data-driven culture. You will champion enterprise self-service analytics, empower business users with trusted and governed data, and serve as Penn Foster Group's thought leader for Business Intelligence, analytics innovation, and data strategy. A key measure of success will be increasing enterprise adoption of self-service analytics while significantly reducing manual and ad hoc reporting requests. Working closely with executive leadership, Product Management, Data Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, Information Security, and business stakeholders, you will shape Penn Foster Group's technology vision while mentoring and developing the next generation of Business Intelligence professionals.

Why Join Penn Foster?

This is an opportunity to:

  • Lead Penn Foster Group's transformation to a self-service analytics organization.
  • Shape the future architecture of our modern data, analytics, and AI platform.
  • Influence enterprise technology strategy and Business Intelligence standards.
  • Build and mentor a growing Business Intelligence team.
  • Work with modern technologies including Databricks, Power BI, Tableau, Azure DevOps, CI/CD, and cloud analytics platforms.
  • Deliver measurable business impact by increasing data literacy, enabling self-service analytics, and accelerating data-driven decision making across the enterprise.

Key Responsibilities Business Intelligence Strategy & Self-Service Analytics

  • Lead the enterprise Business Intelligence strategy, architecture, and roadmap with a focus on expanding self-service analytics capabilities.
  • Champion adoption of self-service analytics by establishing governance, certified datasets, reusable semantic models, and enterprise reporting standards.
  • Develop and execute an enterprise adoption strategy that empowers business users to independently access trusted data and insights while reducing reliance on manual reporting and ad hoc requests.
  • Serve as Penn Foster Group's Business Intelligence thought leader by evaluating emerging technologies, AI capabilities, and industry best practices.
  • Establish KPIs that measure self-service adoption, platform utilization, analytics maturity, and business value.

Enterprise BI Architecture & Engineering

  • Architect and implement enterprise Business Intelligence solutions using Power BI, Tableau, SAP BusinessObjects, and Databricks.
  • Design scalable semantic models, enterprise data models, and governed reporting solutions supporting self-service analytics.
  • Define enterprise standards for architecture, security, governance, visualization, and performance optimization.
  • Serve as the Business Intelligence subject matter expert for the organization's Databricks Lakehouse platform, partnering with Data Engineering to deliver modern analytics solutions.
  • Design and implement enterprise security utilizing Row-Level Security (RLS), Object-Level Security (OLS), and governance best practices.
  • Partner with Data Engineering to optimize ETL/ELT processes, curated datasets, and enterprise reporting models.
  • Lead modernization initiatives including migration from legacy reporting platforms and adoption of emerging cloud and AI technologies.

Engineering Excellence & Delivery

  • Establish DevOps and CI/CD standards utilizing Azure DevOps, Git, source control, automated deployments, and release management.
  • Lead Business Intelligence initiatives within a fast-paced Agile environment using Jira and Scrum methodologies, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Mentor and develop Business Intelligence Analysts and Developers through technical leadership, architecture reviews, coaching, and knowledge sharing.
  • Partner with executive leadership and cross-functional teams to align analytics initiatives with strategic business priorities.

Required Qualifications Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 8+ years of progressive experience in Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, Data Warehousing, or Enterprise Reporting.
  • Minimum 3 years of technical leadership experience leading enterprise Business Intelligence initiatives or teams.

Technical Expertise

Expert-level experience with:

  • Microsoft Power BI
  • Tableau
  • SAP BusinessObjects
  • Databricks (Delta Lake, SQL Warehouses, Unity Catalog, Lakehouse Architecture)
  • SQL, enterprise data modeling, semantic modeling, and data warehousing
  • Business Intelligence architecture, governance, and enterprise security (RLS/OLS)
  • ETL/ELT processes and cloud analytics platforms
  • Azure DevOps, Git, DevOps, and CI/CD pipeline implementation
  • Performance optimization for enterprise reporting solutions

Leadership & Business Skills

  • Proven success implementing enterprise self-service analytics programs that drive adoption and reduce manual reporting.
  • Demonstrated experience leading organizational change and championing a data-driven culture.
  • Experience establishing Business Intelligence governance, Centers of Excellence, and enterprise best practices.
  • Demonstrated success mentoring Business Intelligence Analysts and technical teams.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced Agile environment using Jira and modern Scrum practices.
  • Exceptional communication, collaboration, strategic thinking, and executive presentation skills with the ability to influence stakeholders across all levels of the organization.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Analytics, or related field.
  • Microsoft Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Tableau, Databricks, or SAP BusinessObjects certifications.
  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse Analytics, Snowflake, Microsoft Purview, Collibra, Alation, or other modern cloud data governance and analytics platforms.

Success Measures

Success in this role will be demonstrated by:

  • Successfully leading Penn Foster Group's transformation to a self-service analytics organization.
  • Increasing enterprise adoption and active usage of Business Intelligence platforms and governed self-service analytics.
  • Significantly reducing ad hoc reporting requests by enabling business users to independently access trusted data and insights.
  • Establishing scalable Business Intelligence architecture, governance, security, and DevOps standards that support future AI and analytics initiatives.
  • Delivering secure, high-performing analytics solutions that accelerate business decision making.
  • Building and mentoring a high-performing Business Intelligence team while fostering technical excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement.

Work Environment & Hiring Requirements

  • Role Assessment: Candidates will be required to complete a role-specific assessment as the first step in the hiring process. Assessment results will be used to evaluate alignment with the position and determine next steps in the process.
  • Recorded Video Interviews: All video interviews conducted during the hiring process will be recorded to support internal hiring consistency and process improvement.
  • Background Checks: Employment with Penn Foster Group is contingent upon successfully completing applicable pre-employment screening requirements, which may include verification of employment history, education, and criminal background, where permitted by law.
  • Identity Verification (Form I-9): As part of our onboarding process, all hires must complete employment eligibility verification in compliance with federal law. This includes remote Form I-9 verification, which may require an in-person identity verification step with an authorized representative.
  • On-Camera Work Environment: We operate in a highly collaborative, remote, on-camera culture when working remotely. Employees are expected to be on camera during meetings unless extenuating circumstances apply.

About Us: At Penn Foster Group, we are transforming online learning to help learners by uniting Penn Foster, CareerStep, Ashworth College, James Madison High School, the New York Institute of Photography, the New York Institute of Art and Design, and other education platforms. Together, we create an accelerated path to greater economic mobility through real-world skills and knowledge that enable them to achieve long-term success in the workplaces of the future. Our history dates back to 1890 when our founder, Thomas Foster, pioneered distance education by offering training by mail for coal miners to get the necessary skills for safer jobs. Today, with the partners who use our education and training programs, we continue that mission of providing accessible training and education for in-demand skills and are building a workforce that’s prepared for the future job market. Technology Production Supervisor

Position Summary

Technology Production is the layer where client work becomes reliable, repeatable, and scalable — the emails, banners, landing pages, websites, custom applications, and client-specific product implementations our pharma clients depend on. The Technology Production Supervisor is the hands-on technical leader who runs that production day to day.

This is a technical role, not a project management role. You will work closely with project managers and with every department — creative, product engineering, platform, marketing ops, and account teams — but your value is technical: guiding developers, reviewing work, translating ambiguous requests into clear technical requirements, keeping delivery on track, and being the person the team and clients turn to when something needs to get built or fixed. It is the kind of hands-on technical leadership the function's senior developers provide today.

Key Responsibilities

•Be the SME on everything we produce. Serve as the subject-matter expert on all Technology Production deliverables and products — emails, banners, EHR units, landing pages, WordPress/CMS, custom websites and applications, and our client-specific product implementations.

•Lead day-to-day technical delivery. Attend project kickoffs, scope work technically, and guide the development team from intake through build, QA, and delivery.

•Own allocation and resourcing. Decide who works on what, today — balancing a fast-moving agency pipeline where priorities shift and work arrives with little notice.

•Spot-check quality. Light-touch reviews to catch clearly broken things — not deep code audits. AI, automated tests, and QA increasingly cover this, and other developers can do deeper code reviews when needed; you set the quality bar and step in where it matters (e.g., regulated/MLR accuracy).

•Triage and resolve technical issues. Act as the first escalation point when something breaks across our sites or deliverables; unblock developers and answer their questions.

•Translate business needs into technical requirements. Because project managers are not technical, you bridge the gap — turning client and business requests into precise, buildable specs, and telling PMs and clients what's actually needed to get things done.

•Keep delivery on time. Track developer progress and timelines; flag and resolve risks before they become misses.

•Partner across departments. Coordinate with creative, product engineering, platform/tech-ops, marketing ops, and account teams; route work to the right place and keep hand-offs clean.

•Be a technical and client-facing partner. Represent Technology Production credibly to clients on technical matters.

•Drive automation and AI enablement. Contribute to runbooks and consistent process, and actively apply AI / agentic tools and automated workflows to make production faster, cheaper, and more reliable.

•Coordinate contractors and vendors. Oversee onshore/nearshore contract developers and keep vendor delivery on standard.

Success Measures

  • Demonstrates accountability for outcomes and deadlines
  • Builds strong internal and external partnerships
  • Adapts to change with professionalism and resilience
  • Delivers work aligned with quality, timeliness, and business impact

•Experience producing the deliverable types we build: HTML emails, banners, landing pages, WordPress/CMS, and custom websites/applications.

•Experience leading or coordinating developers (or contractors), with the judgment to allocate work and keep a team on track.

•Ability to translate ambiguous, non-technical requests into clear technical requirements — and to communicate them to PMs, clients, and other departments.

•Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration; comfortable being client-facing.

•Strong attention to detail and QA discipline; able to hold work to regulated-content standards.

•Comfort with agency pace — shifting priorities, tight deadlines, and hands-on allocation.

•An AI-forward, agentic mindset — actively uses AI and agentic tools (ideally including local models) to speed and improve production, with the discipline to verify output for regulated work.

Preferred Qualifications

•Pharma / healthcare or other regulated-industry experience (MLR, ISI, job codes).

•Veeva (Approved Email / CLM) or comparable CRM/marketing-platform experience — or the appetite to own it.

•DevOps / CI experience and an automation mindset (scripting, AI-enabled workflows).

jobs.description:
We’re hiring a Clinical Product Specialist to advance the usefulness and trustworthiness of Blueprint’s AI tools for mental health professionals.

Building AI for clinicians requires more than adding clinical review at the end of the product-development process. Clinical judgment must shape how problems are defined, how systems are designed, and how quality is measured. We're looking for someone who has actually done the work—sat with a client in acute risk and decided what to do next, chosen an intervention and adjusted it when it wasn't landing, managed a full week of sessions and everything that surrounds them—and who can bring that judgment directly into how our products get built. You’ll develop evaluation methods, improve AI behavior, identify failure modes, and help teams make thoughtful clinical, product, and business trade-offs.

This is not a traditional clinical-advisory position. You’ll work hands-on with AI systems while serving as a clinical expert among clinicians, product managers, designers, and engineers. You’ll turn nuanced clinical needs into clear product requirements and measurable quality standards, then help carry solutions from an ambiguous problem through a successful release.

What you’ll own

  • Define what clinically excellent AI output looks like for the product surfaces you support, translating clinical judgment into clear standards and measurable criteria. That typically includes designing and maintaining clinical evaluation suites, including representative test cases, scoring rubrics, benchmarks, and processes for identifying regressions
  • Ground those standards in evidence-based practice and real-world care delivery, for example how a clinician actually reasons through a case, selects and sequences interventions, responds and documents risk, and what a clinician needs in order to trust and act on what the product tells them
  • Work hands-on with prompts, models, and product workflows to improve quality, analyze failure modes, and determine when solutions are ready for customers
  • Set the clinical bar for how our products handle high-acuity content and define what appropriate handling looks like in an AI-assisted workflow
  • Contribute to ambiguous clinical-product initiatives from problem definition through a shippable plan, working alongside product, engineering, design, and other stakeholders on the right trade-offs to make
  • Partner directly with customers and clinical leaders to understand their workflows and concerns, translate their needs into product requirements, and build confidence in Blueprint’s approach
  • Contribute to clinical-quality methodology and reusable practices that raise the standard of AI product development across Blueprint

Who we’re looking for

  • You’re a licensed behavioral health clinician with direct-care experience and strong clinical judgment.
  • You’re fluent in evidence-based approaches such as CBT, ACT, DBT, and MI, and know how to select, adapt, and evaluate interventions.
  • You’ve practiced measurement-based care, using outcomes and progress data to guide treatment.
  • You have experience assessing clinical risk—including suicidality and higher-acuity presentations—and understand responsible documentation and escalation.
  • You understand how clinicians work in practice, from planning sessions and evolving treatment plans to managing caseloads and time pressure.
  • You’ve contributed to AI-enabled, digital health, or similarly technical clinical initiatives; experience with behavioral health documentation or workflows is especially valuable.
  • You’re comfortable evaluating and improving generative AI systems through prompt iteration, structured evaluation, output review, and failure-mode analysis.
  • You can translate clinical nuance into clear product requirements and measurable quality standards, partnering effectively with product managers and engineers.
  • You communicate credibly with clinical leaders and enterprise customers and explain product decisions with clarity and sound clinical reasoning.
  • You’re curious, analytical, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership amid early-stage ambiguity.

Training or applied experience in clinical research, program evaluation, or implementation science is a plus.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and equity
  • 100% remote – no office, no commuting
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance, with 75% of your premium covered by Blueprint
  • Semi-annual team gatherings (in Chicago!)
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Opportunities to grow with the company and shape our product
  • Hardworking, mission-driven, friendly coworkers

Blueprint is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.

jobs.title: Innovative Project Planner (German-speaker) - Remote (Latam)
jobs.excerpt: Are you a bit tired of the standard, old-fashioned way of doing things in the construction industry?
jobs.description:
Are you a bit tired of the standard, old-fashioned way of doing things in the construction industry?
Do you get deep satisfaction from making things run more efficiently using a good dose of common sense and maybe a bit of technology?
Have you always cared about the importance of proper planning and the connection between the schedule and the real, day-to-day delivery of the job?
Have you ever wanted to work a bit more flexibly but still be hands-on in construction and improving the industry?
Sounds like a dream. Well, it isn’t. It’s quite real! Read on.

We are Laminar Projects!

If you’ve already heard about us, you’re probably reading this because you’re tired of the typical, chaotic ways of doing things in construction. But in case you haven’t, we’re a high-end project management consultancy and tech developer with a focus on upgrading the way construction projects are delivered.
Improving construction strengthens the very foundation of human civilisation. (Check out our short film about it.)
We bring transparency and control to projects through a pragmatic mix of the latest tech, our own processes, and a big dose of common sense. We then take our deep understanding of these projects and we invest heavily into developing the digital solutions that anyone can use to deliver their projects better. (Check out Shape, our construction management tech, to see what we’re doing.)
The core of all this is our true secret sauce: our people. We only recruit the very best, both in capability and personality. We’re deeply focused on designing a new type of organisation that’s optimised for the flourishing of the people in the team first and foremost. People who join us develop fast as a whole person in ways they never imagined. (Read more about our vision and missions.)
This approach has allowed us to grow from just two people in 2017 to over 220 today. We have a stable, repeat client base across infrastructure and complex building projects in the UK and internationally, and we’re still growing fast. Joining us isn’t just some “job”. It’s a transformative educational experience. We challenge you to be your best self in all aspects of life. There are many diverse and interesting challenges available. It’s up to you to guide yourself into whichever areas you’re most interested – we’ll enable it.
(Get to know us better by watching a few more of our videos.)

Core values for a good life

A life of human flourishing is all about meaningful relationships and challenging yourself to create a positive impact, so our values reflect the four levels of relationships that each of us has:
  • Grow yourself – your relationship with yourself
  • Care about people – your relationship with others around you
  • Execute to greatness – your relationship with your team
  • Build civilisation – your relationship with humanity and the world

We enshrined our values in our vision:

We exist so that everyone in our team can flourish in a high-impact community that:
  • Connects us with meaningful relationships
  • Inspires us to develop ourselves to become better humans
  • Empowers us to pursue our own learning adventures
By first doing this, we can achieve the highest levels of value for the world.
And enable the achievement of our vision through our two missions:
  • To fully digitalise the construction of human civilisation
  • To create a new type of organisation that enables human flourishing while delivering a huge positive impact on society

The Role

Purpose of the role

You’ll be enhancing the delivery of the most complex and interesting projects in the world through the power of project planning to the very highest standards. You’ll devise strategies and tactics to improve the way the project is delivered. You’ll translate this knowledge into a logic-linked plan and analyse it using planning software. Then you’ll use the plan to help the teams understand what to prioritise.

Your team

This role is part of our Project Management Consultancy team which focuses on:
  • Understanding what the real problems of projects are
  • Implementing the best solutions to those problems
  • Developing scalable best practices, tools and technology
More specifically, you’ll be part of our Project Planning Team, who are industry leaders in the planning of complex construction projects. Your initial leader will be one of our planning discipline directors.

Your top three objectives

1. To make construction projects deliver to near perfection
2. To create scalable and repeatable solutions to common problems
3. To develop yourself and everyone around you

Your top five responsibilities

1. Own the plan: Own the project plan for one or more projects and ensure that the project is working to it effectively. Ensure delays are mitigated and managed commercially
2. Own the outcome: You're responsible for putting in your best effort to ensure the project team’s understanding and focus on the plan – no matter how stubborn they are
3. Report and inform: Provide simple, actionable reports to stakeholders at all levels that help them deliver their part of the project more efficiently and effectively
4. Make scalable solutions: Develop scalable and repeatable best practices and tools in collaboration with the team so that long-term impact is achieved
5. Develop everyone: Maximise the development of your team personally and professionally and educate our clients to improve as well

You must have:

  • A construction engineering background: You have at least 2+ years of experience on construction projects, experience in project planning both software and principles, as well as decent Excel skills, and a strong interest in data
  • Communication skills: You’re proficient in written and verbal English and have the charisma and influence to get construction people to do new things and take the best approach
  • Leadership capabilities: You lead yourself proactively and lead others by asking the right questions and challenging them
  • Impact: You have a track record of making projects and organisations better beyond just doing the basics – implementing scalable, repeatable solutions that had a significant positive impact
Laminar isn’t the place for you if any of the following is true:
  • You want an easy, chilled-out role without much challenge
  • You like to be the smartest person in the room
  • You don’t like continuously receiving honest candid feedback
  • You prefer to do your own thing rather than work with a team

Frequently Asked Questions

What kinds of projects would I be working on?
It’s common for people to be exposed to several projects in their first year with us. You’ll work on some of the most complex and interesting environments in the world. We’ve delivered over 100 data centres internationally, many of them fast-tracked and multi-package. Our teams have supported flagship infrastructure programmes like HS2 through integrated planning and digital delivery, contributed to over $30bn in power generation and transmission projects, and played a key role in the development of high-containment labs and R&D campuses for some of the world’s most advanced industrial and life sciences clients. You might find yourself working in sectors such as data centres, infrastructure (including defense, rail, and highways), high tech (such as advanced manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, and semiconductors), or complex building projects. These aren’t hands-off assignments. They’re dynamic, hands-on environments designed for people who want to be challenged. We bring back the lessons from every project to help our team grow and deliver the highest levels of value. (Check out our case stories.)

Who are our clients?

Major owners/operators and main contractors with project values between £1m and £1bn+ globally.

Where would I be working?

One week you might be working from home. The next, you might travel to the site to meet the construction teams and help organise them. Maybe you’ll pop into our London office for a workshop or a beer. Maybe you’ll fly out to exotic (and sometimes not!) locations in Europe or the Middle East to visit clients. It really depends on what you want to get involved in and what fits with your life.
How does what I do connect with the long-term impact on the construction industry?
You’re tasked with understanding and solving common problems. We don’t want to reinvent the wheel every time, so you’ll be responsible for documenting new solutions and evolving ones we’ve developed. This goes into our knowledge repository, which we’re going to open source to the industry.
The knowledge you capture will be used by us to build new products. You’ll constantly test those products in the field, so we can rapidly iterate and improve them for anyone in the industry to use.

Important! Applying properly

We get thousands of applications so please write us a letter as part of your application explaining:
  • Why you want to join us
  • What you’ll bring to the team
We aren't a giant, faceless corporation; we really care about the people who want to join our team, so your letter will be read carefully. After that, we’ll reach out to you to schedule a casual conversation to help you get to know us a bit better and tell us a bit about yourself. A couple of technical and personal assessments follow to understand your capability based on our own development matrix.
This is to ensure that when you join, you’re starting at the right level of responsibility.

  • Familiarity with AI/ML, vector search, or retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
  • Exposure to mobile/edge or real-time analytics workloads.

jobs.excerpt: About HoneHone is an online medical clinic at the forefront of transforming healthcare and enhancing longevity.
jobs.description:
About Hone

Hone is an online medical clinic at the forefront of transforming healthcare and enhancing longevity. We use cutting-edge scientific advancements to empower men and women to take control of their health and unlock their full potential. Our people are the heart of everything we do and drive our success. We approach every project through our brand values:

  • Fight for the Customer
  • Execute Ruthlessly
  • Communicate Candidly, Clearly, and Kindly
  • Collaborate Selflessly
  • Practice Calculated Risk-Taking
  • Maximize Joy and Gratitude

Hone has been fully virtual from day one and will continue to be a remote-first employer.

Our Ideal Candidate

Our ideal candidate is a mission-driven, motivated multi-tasker who is invested in work that is fulfilling and impactful. They embrace change and tackle challenges with enthusiasm. They have an “all-in” disposition towards work, understanding that we are a fast-paced, high-growth organization with evolving priorities. They can excel at both independent tasks and collaborative work, leading with clear and candid communication. They exhibit humble leadership—the ability to drive initiatives forward while remaining excited about continuous learning and development opportunities. They feel strongly about being part of a team that advocates for people to live longer and better lives.

The Role

Hone is looking for a Quality Engineer II to join our Engineering team. This is an early-career role for someone who has a year or two of testing under their belt and is ready to own the quality of their own features. You will report to the Director of QA and work alongside senior quality and software engineers who will help you keep growing.

At Hone, there is one Quality Engineer track. You will both test and automate, and you will use AI to do both faster. You will handle small features and bugs with little supervision, deliver scoped work on time, and build the judgment that carries you toward Quality Engineer III and beyond. This is not a manual-only or a script-running role - it is a real engineering career on a clear path.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Write and maintain test cases for your own features with little guidance, covering the happy path and the obvious edge cases, and raise risks when you spot them
  • Own testing for the small features and bugs assigned to you, delivering scoped work on time without much hand-holding
  • Write reliable automated tests for your features on your own (end-to-end tests in Playwright and API-level tests) following the team’s conventions
  • Chase down flaky tests and keep your part of the suite stable, asking for help when you need it
  • Run exploratory checks and write clear, reproducible bug reports that anyone on the team can act on
  • Work with AI tools day to day to draft cases, automation, and selectors - and spot and fix output that is wrong or unsafe, following the team’s AI conventions
  • Apply patient-data guardrails consistently: keep test data synthetic and never put real patient data in test cases, bug reports, or any other test artifact
  • Give short, useful code and test reviews, talk through the direction of your own work, and give teammates helpful feedback

Qualifications

  • Roughly 1-2 years of experience in software quality, testing, or test automation
  • Working programming or scripting ability in at least one language (TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, or C#)
  • Comfortable writing automated tests and maintaining them, ideally with Playwright or comparable UI and API testing frameworks
  • Comfortable with version control (Git), running a test suite, and basic debugging on your own
  • Works with AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Codex, or similar) as part of a daily workflow, and reviews their output rather than trusting it blindly
  • Dependable communication: clear bug reports, useful reviews, and the habit of talking through your own work
  • A track record of finishing scoped work on time with little supervision
  • A genuine interest in healthcare and in protecting the patients who rely on our platform

We do not expect you to meet every line above. If you are an early-career quality engineer and most of this resonates, please apply.

Compensation

$80,000 - $105,000 annual salary

Benefits*

Hone wants our team to be in the best condition of their lives, so we offer a range of benefits including:

  • A remote-first work environment
  • Competitive compensation and equity options
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance coverage
  • Short-term disability and basic life coverage
  • Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs)
  • Lifestyle Spending Accounts (LSAs)
  • We follow federal holidays and have uncapped time off for exempt employees
  • Budget for the technology tools you need (laptop, monitor, and/or special software)
  • A focus on company-sponsored activities to foster engagement (both virtual and in-person)
  • Waived membership fees for any Hone team members utilizing Hone products

*These benefits are available to full-time, regular employees, and not to independent contractors, part-time employees, temporary employees, or interns.

Job Title:

Growth Strategy & Operations

Position Description:

As Sr Director of Enterprise Program Success, you will lead the growth strategy for a focused portfolio of our largest, highest-potential enterprise clients. These relationships are central to Ren’s long-term commercial success. You are not a relationship manager in the traditional sense. You are a growth architect: someone who builds deep trust at every level of a client organization, identifies where the next level of partnership is achievable, and owns a structured plan to get there – driving sustainable, scalable growth in alignment with Ren’s risk and compliance standards. This is the role for someone who has spent their career at the intersection of strategy, client relationships, and execution.

Duties & Responsibilities:

Owning the Account Plan and Growth Outcomes

You carry full accountability for the growth trajectory of a focused portfolio of 2–3 enterprise accounts. You own the plan, and you own the results.

  • Define and own growth goals for each account: incremental philanthropic gift volume, product module adoption, financial advisor penetration, and more
  • Build account-specific growth plans that are active, living strategies – regularly tested, refined, and tied to measurable outcomes – and designed to maximize growth potential within responsible risk parameters
  • Develop a quantitative firm-specific model of growth: understand which levers drive which outcomes, validate through data and customer feedback loops (NPS, focus groups, experimentation), and maintain accountability to measurable performance standards
  • Prioritize and sequence growth initiatives through structured evaluation of opportunity size, strategic fit, resource requirements, and risk/return trade-offs – with appropriate escalation of material risks – then build the alignment to execute, both on the client side and internally

Building Relationships That Drive Impact

You will build and sustain relationships across the full depth of each client organization — with the decision-makers, influencers, and operators who shape what's actually possible.

  • Cultivate executive-level relationships spanning senior leadership, business unit heads, regional leadership, operations, technology, and philanthropy teams
  • Develop and maintain a deliberate system for tracking and managing key stakeholders; mapping influencers, champions, and decision-makers; understanding their priorities, and keeping Ren present and relevant at every level
  • Act as a credible strategic advisor to client leadership: understand their competitive landscape, organizational goals, and philanthropic strategy well enough to speak to their agenda, not just our own
  • Build business cases alongside client stakeholders that justify incremental investment in giving-related integrations – helping them make the internal case as effectively as you make ours

Turning Client Complexity Into Growth Infrastructure

Large enterprise clients are ecosystems with established workflows and interdependencies, layered technology, and many stakeholders who shape whether things run smoothly. Your job is to understand that ecosystem and use it as a foundation for growth.

  • Map core user journeys end-to-end to identify opportunities for deeper integration into financial advisor workflows, making it easy for financial advisors to utilize Ren-supported offerings
  • Partner closely with Ren's product and operations teams to develop workflow solutions shaped by client needs, ensuring the client's voice informs what we build and that adoption follows
  • Engage client-side ops, technology, and business leaders as partners in designing and implementing integrations
  • Translate client feedback into actionable product roadmap input; close the loop between what clients need and what Ren delivers

Orchestrating the Internal Team Behind the Account

Execution at this scale requires coordinating across many contributors. You are responsible for leading through others – coordinating across functions to drive alignment, structured delivery, and customer-centric progress consistent with organizational priorities.

  • Lead cross-functional coordination across marketing, field/relationship teams, analytics, product, and operations
  • Own the top-line performance story: build account-level reporting and dashboards, and keep senior leadership current on account health, growth trajectory, risks, and mitigation
  • Work across partner product marketing, charitable strategists, and operations leads to ensure go-to-client readiness across the account ecosystem

Education & Experience:

  • Bachelors degree in business management, sales, or other related field.
  • 8–12 years in enterprise growth, strategic account management, or management consulting, with meaningful exposure to financial institutions, fintech, or financial services; experience in regulated environments preferred
  • In depth understanding how operations and product capabilities translate into growth, and how to use that knowledge to identify opportunities, shape what gets built, and drive adoption on the client side.
  • Demonstrated ownership of growth outcomes with a track record of accelerating performance in complex, high-value accounts
  • Fluency in the relationship between product, operations, and commercial outcomes; able to connect client needs to internal capabilities and drive execution across both
  • Strong analytical mindset: able to model growth opportunities, assess resource trade-offs, and build rigorous business cases
  • Exceptional executive presence: comfortable with C-suite engagement, able to craft and land high-stakes presentations
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams through influence and informal authority, driving execution across marketing, product, field organizations, and more
  • Self-directed leader who can create structure in ambiguous situations, move from strategy to execution, and navigate the compliance and operational constraints typical of fintech environments

SAP SD Consultant – Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: SAP SD Consultant
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $130,000–$190,000 Annually
Experience Required: 7+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced SAP SD Consultant to lead the implementation, enhancement, and support of enterprise SAP Sales and Distribution (SD) solutions across complex Order-to-Cash (OTC) business processes. This role focuses on delivering scalable SAP S/4HANA solutions supporting global sales operations, pricing, shipping, billing, customer management, and third-party system integrations.
You will work closely with business stakeholders, functional consultants, technical teams, SAP Basis administrators, and integration architects to design and configure SAP SD solutions that improve operational efficiency, streamline business processes, and support digital transformation initiatives. The ideal candidate possesses strong expertise in SAP SD configuration, cross-functional integration, and S/4HANA implementation projects while maintaining a deep understanding of end-to-end Order-to-Cash business processes.

Key Responsibilities
  • Analyze business requirements and translate them into scalable SAP SD functional solutions.
  • Configure and support SAP Sales and Distribution modules including Sales Orders, Deliveries, Billing, Shipping, Pricing, Output Management, and Returns Processing.
  • Lead end-to-end implementation and enhancement projects across Order-to-Cash (OTC) business processes.
  • Configure customer master data, material master integration, sales organizations, distribution channels, divisions, shipping points, plants, and sales areas.
  • Design and configure pricing procedures, condition techniques, tax determination, rebates, discounts, freight, and promotional pricing.
  • Configure copy controls, item categories, schedule line categories, incompletion procedures, and document flows.
  • Collaborate with ABAP developers to develop functional specifications for reports, interfaces, enhancements, forms, workflows, BADIs, User Exits, and IDOCs.
  • Support SAP S/4HANA migration, system upgrades, and business transformation initiatives.
  • Integrate SAP SD with MM, FI/CO, PP, WM, EWM, TM, GTS, CRM, and external third-party applications.
  • Develop functional documentation including Business Process Documents (BPDs), Functional Specifications (FS), Configuration Documents, and Test Scripts.
  • Support SIT, UAT, regression testing, production deployments, and hypercare activities.
  • Troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis, and provide ongoing production support.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, solution design workshops, and architecture review sessions.

Required Skills
  • Seven or more years of hands-on SAP SD consulting experience supporting enterprise SAP environments.
  • Strong expertise in SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA Sales and Distribution configuration.
  • Extensive knowledge of Order-to-Cash (OTC) business processes.
  • Hands-on experience configuring Sales Orders, Deliveries, Billing, Returns, Credit Management, Output Determination, and Shipping processes.
  • Strong experience configuring pricing procedures, condition techniques, access sequences, pricing routines, taxes, rebates, and discounts.
  • Experience with customer master, material master, business partner configuration, and partner determination.
  • Strong understanding of copy controls, item categories, schedule line categories, route determination, shipping determination, and transportation scheduling.
  • Experience integrating SAP SD with MM, FI, PP, WM/EWM, TM, CRM, and other SAP modules.
  • Experience preparing Functional Specifications for ABAP developments including Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Enhancements, Forms, and Workflows (RICEFW).
  • Familiarity with IDOCs, BAPIs, RFCs, APIs, EDI, and middleware integration technologies.
  • Experience supporting SAP interfaces with Salesforce, E-commerce platforms, Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), Transportation Management Systems (TMS), and third-party logistics providers.
  • Experience with SAP Solution Manager, ChaRM, SAP Fiori, and SAP GUI.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and business process optimization skills.
  • Experience working in Agile Scrum or SAP Activate implementation methodologies.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience participating in multiple full lifecycle SAP S/4HANA implementation projects.
  • Familiarity with SAP Fiori Apps, SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), and SAP Integration Suite.
  • Experience with Advanced ATP (aATP), Variant Configuration (VC), and SAP Global Trade Services (GTS).
  • Knowledge of SAP Transportation Management (TM) and Extended Warehouse Management (EWM).
  • Experience supporting multinational organizations with global sales operations.
  • Familiarity with SAP Revenue Accounting, Intercompany Sales, Cross-Company Sales, and International Trade processes.
  • Experience integrating SAP with Salesforce, MuleSoft, Boomi, or other enterprise integration platforms.
  • SAP Certified Application Associate or SAP Certified Professional certification in SAP SD or SAP S/4HANA Sales is highly desirable.
  • Experience supporting highly regulated industries including manufacturing, healthcare, retail, consumer products, or life sciences.
  • Knowledge of SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) and reporting solutions is a plus.

Project Environment
You will be joining a global SAP transformation program responsible for modernizing enterprise Order-to-Cash processes across multiple business units. Current initiatives include:
  • SAP S/4HANA Greenfield and Brownfield implementation projects
  • Global Order-to-Cash process standardization
  • Advanced Pricing and Revenue Management solutions
  • Integration with Salesforce CRM and enterprise eCommerce platforms
  • Warehouse Management (EWM) and Transportation Management (TM) integration
  • Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) modernization
  • SAP Fiori application rollout and user experience enhancements
  • Enterprise workflow automation and approval processes
  • Cloud-based SAP integrations using SAP BTP and Integration Suite
This is a hands-on functional consulting role where you will contribute to solution architecture, SAP SD configuration, business process optimization, system integration, testing, production support, and continuous improvement of mission-critical enterprise SAP platforms.

O profissional atuará principalmente na integração entre o ERP MV, a plataforma Planisa e as soluções de gestão de custos e indicadores hospitalares, garantindo que os processos assistenciais, administrativos e financeiros sejam traduzidos em requisitos consistentes para implementação de melhorias e projetos de transformação digital.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Levantar, analisar e documentar requisitos funcionais junto às áreas assistenciais, administrativas e financeiras.
  • Atuar como interface entre usuários, equipes técnicas e fornecedores de sistemas.
  • Mapear processos de negócio e identificar oportunidades de melhoria e automação.
  • Elaborar especificações funcionais, regras de negócio, fluxos de processos e casos de uso.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de integração entre o ERP MV, Planisa, KPIH e demais sistemas corporativos.

  • Apoiar testes funcionais, testes integrados e homologações junto aos usuários-chave.
  • Garantir a rastreabilidade entre requisitos, desenvolvimento e entregas.
  • Elaborar documentação funcional e manter atualizada a base de conhecimento dos sistemas.
  • Apoiar projetos de implantação de novos módulos, melhorias e atualizações tecnológicas.
  • Contribuir para iniciativas de governança de processos e melhoria contínua.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Ensino Superior completo em Sistemas de Informação, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Administração, Gestão Hospitalar ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência como Analista de Requisitos, Analista de Negócios ou Analista Funcional.
  • Conhecimento do ERP MV.
  • Experiência com a plataforma Planisa.
  • Conhecimento dos processos de custeio hospitalar e controladoria.
  • Experiência no levantamento e documentação de requisitos funcionais.
  • Conhecimento em modelagem de processos (BPMN ou equivalente).
  • Vivência em testes funcionais e homologação de sistemas.
  • Conhecimento em SQL para consultas e validação de dados.

  • Rateio de custos assistenciais e administrativos.
  • Contabilidade gerencial aplicada à saúde.
  • BPMN.
  • UML (casos de uso e diagramas funcionais).
  • SQL Server e/ou Oracle.
  • APIs REST e Web Services (conceitos).
  • Ferramentas de gestão de requisitos (Azure DevOps, Jira, Confluence ou similares).
  • Excel avançado e Power BI.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em hospitais de média ou alta complexidade.
  • Conhecimento do método de custeio por absorção e custeio baseado em atividades (ABC).
  • Vivência em projetos de Business Intelligence ou Data Warehouse na área da saúde.
  • Experiência em integrações envolvendo HL7, FHIR ou outras tecnologias de interoperabilidade.
  • Conhecimento dos processos de faturamento hospitalar e indicadores assistenciais.
  • Certificações em Análise de Negócios (CBAP, CCBA ou equivalentes).
  • Conhecimento de metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).

Competências Comportamentais

  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita.
  • Capacidade de negociação entre áreas de negócio e tecnologia.
  • Pensamento analítico e visão sistêmica.

  • Perfil consultivo e orientado à solução de problemas.
  • Trabalho colaborativo.
  • Proatividade e senso de prioridade.

Principais Desafios da Posição

Perfil Procurado

Procuramos um profissional com sólida experiência em análise de requisitos e forte conhecimento dos processos hospitalares, especialmente nas áreas de custos, controladoria e gestão financeira. Principal, Product Management

Descriptor: This role aligns to indsiutryu level titles such as Princiapl Product Manager

Location: US, Remote

About the Role

We embrace an SVPG-inspired Product Operating Model, empowering our product teams to solve hard customer and business problems – in ways that our customers love, yet work for our business. Product companies depend on strong products, and strong products come from strong product teams. And we recognize that product teams are only as strong as their product managers.
We are hiring an experienced product manager to contribute to our core assessment team for Higher Education. You will be focused on evolving the objective assessment experience to respond to an AI-enabled world, while also maintaining our large, devoted, existing base.
Who you are
You are a curious, hands-on product manager who can own a meaningful slice of a platform end-to-end. You think in outcomes, connect them back to clear value propositions and the jobs your users are trying to get done, and you design measurement before you build. You experiment with current AI tools in your own work and have a sharp view of where AI adds value and where it does not. You break problems down, you are comfortable with engineers on technical trade-offs, and you care about education enough to fight for the right thing.

What you'll work on

Strategy, vision and outcomes

  • Define and maintain a clear vision, value proposition, and roadmap for your area, grounded in user insight, business priorities, and platform strategy.
  • Set outcome-driven goals (OKRs or equivalent) with leading and lagging indicators planned up front – measurement is part of the design, not an afterthought.
  • Make deliberate trade-offs between competing user needs, GTM needs, and platform-wide concerns.
  • Contribute to platform-level strategy, bringing your area into broader roadmap discussions and shaping coherent cross-area decisions.

Discovery and customer insight

  • Build first-hand understanding of your users – their jobs-to-be-done, pain points, and the contexts in which they work – through regular direct engagement.
  • Run continuous discovery using : customer interviews, usability testing, behavioural analysis, and rapid prototyping.
  • Develop empathy for indirect users too – the learners, educators, and administrators who experience the downstream products your platform powers.
  • Be the resident expert in the competitive space for your assigned assessment experience.
  • Lead build/buy/partner analysis to help Pearson HE decide where to invest development dollars and where to partner to fast-track solutions

Delivery, execution and leadership

  • Work with engineering and design as a single team, sharing problem framing and solution design rather than handing over requirements.
  • This is a legacy org in rapid transformation – we need PM’s that act as ‘player coaches’, contributing to building the team – sharing what you learn, mentoring peers, helping raise the bar.
  • Write clear product artefacts – PRDs, specs, capability definitions, user stories – at the right level for the team, so engineering can build without constant clarification.
  • Manage scope and sequencing thoughtfully, balancing strategic bets against near-term commitments and operational needs.

AI and technology

  • Engage credibly with engineering on architecture, API design, and technical trade-offs relevant to your area.
  • Identify and evaluate relevant AI capabilities in a pragmatic way – generative AI, prompt engineering, ML-assisted workflows, intelligent content tools – impact vs feasibility
  • Become the resident expert in how instructors and students are using AI in their classrooms, and how Pearson HE assessments should react.

Stakeholders and storytelling

  • Build strong working relationships with engineering, design, data, content, and GTM partners; operate effectively in a matrix without direct authority.
  • Communicate strategy, progress, and trade-offs clearly to senior stakeholders; surface risks and decisions early.
  • Tell a clear product story – what problem you are solving, for whom, why it matters, and what 'good' looks like – so the team and your stakeholders move in the same direction.

What we're looking for

  • -6+ years of product management experience, with a track record of owning a product or area end-to-end – from discovery through to measurable outcomes.
  • Strong discovery skills; ability to translate insight into product decisions.
  • Experience with B2B2C products serving multiple user types, ideally including both user-facing applications and developer-facing services.
  • Technical acumen – comfortable on architecture and API discussions, and able to make informed trade-offs without needing every detail explained.
  • Data fluency – defines metrics, plans measurement, works with instrumentation, uses quantitative signals alongside qualitative insight.
  • Hands-on experience with current AI tools in your own product work, with a clear view of when AI is and is not the right tool.
  • Strong written and verbal communication – clear opportunity assessments, user stories, and strategic framing that gives teams real direction.
  • Stakeholder management in complex organisations – competing priorities, influence without authority, trust-building across functions.
Bonus experience
  • Background in educational technology
  • Practical experience with AI/ML product development beyond generative AI – classification, recommendation, NLP, vision.
  • Experience with modernizing a software while maintaining the existing user base

Compensation at Pearson is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and specific location. About Cool Earth

Cool Earth is a climate charity that protects the rainforest by supporting the people who live there. We have been working alongside local and Indigenous rainforest communities for over 15 years in the three largest and most important rainforests in the world, the Amazon, The Congo Rainforest and the Papua New Guinea Rainforest. Indigenous and local communities have been protecting the rainforest for thousands of years, but unfortunately are now facing a humanitarian crisis, lacking necessities like safe drinking water, infrastructure, healthcare, and stable incomes.

This makes rainforest communities vulnerable to exploitation by illegal loggers and extractive industries, who pressure them to sell their land. Once these industries take over, Indigenous peoples are displaced, losing their ancestral homes, culture, and traditional ways of life, and the rainforest is destroyed. Without these forests to regulate the earth’s temperature the climate crisis will only worsen. So what do we do to help?

By working in collaboration with these communities we help support their livelihoods, improve health, sanitation and education and provide tech to help monitor their rainforest. Our main programme involves giving direct unconditional cash to rainforest communities so that they can decide how best to use it in order to improve their quality of life. Rainforest communities can only defend their land from illegal loggers and greedy land grabbers when they themselves are resilient and strong. We help them get to that point.

Together, the team collaborates asynchronously across regions to manage a broad book of business and a wide range of opportunity sizes. The team guides customers from initial evaluation through long-term value by developing new business, strengthening customer relationships, and supporting healthy product adoption. jobs.title: Junior Meeting Manager (FR, France , Virtual, EUROPE)
jobs.excerpt: About Us:At BCD Meetings & Events (BCD M&E), we provide more than meeting and event planning services: we create connections that inspire, motivate and change behavior for our customers.
jobs.description:
About Us:

At BCD Meetings & Events (BCD M&E), we provide more than meeting and event planning services: we create connections that inspire, motivate and change behavior for our customers. As the world’s most trusted and innovative meetings and events agency, BCD M&E cultivates a culture of people, passion and purpose to drive business forward.

Headquartered in Chicago, with locations in 60+ countries across the world, BCD M&E’s team of 2,000+ people are committed to sustainability and driving success for our customers, our business and ourselves. Our values are at the heart of everything we do, and we look for people that want to be a part of something special, can rise to our standards and love to bring their unique perspective to the table.

While we can’t guarantee every day will be the best (who can?), we can promise a community of people who genuinely care and lead with empathy, a flexible workplace with awesome perks and challenging work that means something.

See what life is about at BCD M&E at

About the role:

As a Junior Meeting Manager, you’ll support a dedicated client in the pharmaceutical / life sciences industry, helping the team deliver compliant, well-organized meetings and events. This is a junior role focused on administrative and coordination support across event planning, Cvent/registration support, and assistance with reconciliation and compliance documentation.

You’ll work closely with Meeting Managers and external partners to keep programs moving—tracking details, maintaining accurate data, and supporting consistent, high-quality delivery.

As a Junior Meeting Manager, your main tasks will be:

  • Administrative Support (Core Focus): Provide day-to-day coordination and administrative support across multiple meetings/programs (tracking tasks, maintaining files, organizing meeting materials, updating trackers and timelines).
  • Event Planning Support: Assist with logistics such as agendas, attendee communications, supplier information collection, rooming list support, and onsite preparation (where applicable).
  • Cvent / Digital Support: Support builds and updates in Cvent (event websites, registration forms, emails/communications) using existing templates and SOPs; help test registration flows and troubleshoot basic issues if needed.
  • Attendee & Data Management: Help maintain accurate attendee/registration data, monitor changes, and ensure information is updated and aligned across tools and documentation.
  • Reconciliation Support: Assist with gathering invoices/backup, tracking spend, and supporting post-event reconciliation steps in line with client financial controls and internal processes.
  • Compliance & Documentation: Support life sciences compliance requirements by maintaining accurate documentation, ensuring required forms/approvals are stored correctly, and helping meet reporting deadlines.
  • Team Collaboration & Continuous Improvement: Coordinate with teammates to ensure accuracy and consistency; suggest small process improvements (checklists, templates, file organization) to improve efficiency.

You should have:

  • 1+ year of experience in an administrative, coordination, events, travel, or project support role (internships/placements welcome)
  • Interest in meetings & events and comfort working in a structured, deadline-driven environment
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to follow SOPs and compliance-driven processes
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Professional communication skills in English and French (written and verbal)
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and stay organized

Nice to have:

  • Exposure to life sciences/pharma environments or compliance-based work
  • Hands-on experience with Cvent (or similar event/registration platforms)
  • Basic budgeting, invoice tracking, or reconciliation support experience
  • Willingness to travel up to 25% (domestic/international), depending on program needs

What success looks like in this role:

  • Accurate, timely updates to trackers, documentation, and Cvent components
  • Reliable support to planners/project managers that improves speed and quality
  • Strong compliance discipline and excellent attention to detail

The salary range for the role is between 35.000 euro and 39.000 euro gross per year. The actual pay will depends on your qualifications, skills and experience.

À propos du poste :

En tant que Junior Meeting Manager, vous serez dédié à un client du secteur pharmaceutique, en aidant l’équipe à organiser des réunions et des événements conformes et bien structurés. Il s’agit d’un poste junior, axé sur le support administratif et la coordination d’événements, support avec Cvent/inscriptions, ainsi que l’aide à la réconciliation et à la documentation de conformité.

Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les Meeting Managers et des partenaires externes afin d’assurer la bonne avancée des programmes: suivi des détails, maintien de données fiables et contribution à une exécution constante et de qualité.

En tant que Junior Meeting Manager, vous devrez:

  • Support administratif (mission principale): assurer au quotidien la coordination et le support administratif de plusieurs réunions/programmes (suivi des tâches, gestion et mise à jour des dossiers, organisation des supports de réunion, mise à jour des tableaux de suivi et des plannings).
  • Support à la planification d’événements: assister sur la logistique (agendas, communications aux participants, collecte d’informations auprès des fournisseurs, soutien pour les rooming lists, préparation onsite si nécessaire).
  • Support Cvent / digital: contribuer aux créations et mises à jour dans Cvent (sites événementiels, formulaires d’inscription, e-mails/communications) à l’aide des modèles et SOP existants ; aider à tester les parcours d’inscription et résoudre des problèmes simples si nécessaire.
  • Gestion des participants & des données: contribuer au maintien de données participants/inscriptions exactes, suivre les changements et s’assurer que les informations sont à jour et cohérentes entre les outils et la documentation.
  • Support à la réconciliation: aider à rassembler les factures et justificatifs, suivre les dépenses et contribuer aux étapes de réconciliation post-événement, conformément aux contrôles financiers du client et aux processus internes.
  • Conformité & documentation: soutenir les exigences de conformité du secteur sciences de la vie en maintenant une documentation précise, en s’assurant que les formulaires/validations requis sont correctement enregistrés, et en contribuant au respect des délais de reporting.
  • Collaboration & amélioration continue: coordonner avec les membres de l’équipe pour garantir l’exactitude et la cohérence ; proposer de petites améliorations de processus (checklists, modèles, organisation des dossiers) afin de gagner en efficacité.

Vous auriez dû:

  • Expérience dans un rôle de support administratif, coordination, événements, voyages ou support projet (1 an ou plus, stages/alternances bienvenus)
  • Un intérêt pour les réunions & événements, et une aisance dans un environnement structuré, avec des délais
  • Un excellent sens du détail et la capacité à suivre des SOP et des processus orientés conformité
  • Une bonne maîtrise de Microsoft Office (Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Maîtrise du français et de l’anglais en communication orale et écrite
  • La capacité à gérer plusieurs priorités et à rester organisé(e)

Vous pourriez aussi avoir :

  • Expérience sur un client des sciences de la vie
  • Maîtrise du Cvent(ou d’une plateforme similaire de gestion d’événements/inscriptions)
  • Une première expérience en budget, suivi de factures ou support à la réconciliation
  • Jusqu’à 25 % de déplacements (nationaux et internationaux) peuvent être requis

La rémunération pour ce poste se situe entre 35 000 et 39 000 euros bruts par an. Le salaire exact dépendra de vos qualifications, compétences et expérience.

THE PERKS

Flexible Working

We believe that a flexible working environment is key to getting the best out of our teams. We will support you to work where you need to and when you need to, depending on how you work best.

Room to Grow

Our line of work and business structure challenge our people in a way that inspires growth, with learning and development built into every role. We give individuals ownership over the direction and speed in which they grow.

Everyone has a voice

We thrive on conversations that spark curiosity and empathy. No matter how big or how small, every voice is heard, considered and respected.

Make your move

The diversity of roles across BCD M&E’s global locations means that our people often find new adventures during their time with us. Join us as a meeting planner role in the UK, stay for a global marketing career — there’s always room to move.

We’ve got you covered

Our extensive benefits include comprehensive healthcare, retirement plans, continued education support, diverse work locations, travel and hotel discounts, volunteer and sustainability opportunities and a successful employee recognition program.

We’re positive. You’ll love it.

It starts from the top. Our leaders lead with positivity, believe in our people and trust us to do the right thing. There will always be support along your journey, in little and big ways.

jobs.description:
Website Designer (WordPress, Webflow, Figma, HTML/CSS & SEO) – Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Client Business Hours
Location: Remote — LATAM, South Africa, Philippines & Pakistan Preferred

About the Role

We’re hiring a Website Designer to design, build, and optimize modern, responsive, and conversion-focused websites.

This is not purely a graphic design role. You’ll combine UI/UX design with hands-on website implementation, working across platforms such as WordPress, Webflow, Shopify, and Squarespace.

You’ll own projects from visual concepts and layouts through CMS implementation, responsive testing, SEO optimization, and ongoing improvements.

If you have a strong eye for design, understand how websites drive conversions, and are comfortable with Figma, WordPress/Webflow, HTML, and CSS, this role could be a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Website Design & UI/UX

  • Create wireframes, mockups, and responsive website designs using:
    • Figma
    • Adobe XD
    • Sketch
  • Design modern:
    • Landing pages
    • Marketing websites
    • Business websites
    • Campaign pages
  • Apply strong principles around:
    • Visual hierarchy
    • Typography
    • Spacing
    • Navigation
    • Usability
    • Conversion-focused design
  • Maintain consistency with established brand guidelines and design systems.

CMS Development & Website Builds

  • Build and customize websites using:
    • WordPress
    • Webflow
    • Shopify
    • Squarespace
  • Customize themes, templates, and layouts.
  • Use HTML and CSS for custom implementations and styling.
  • Apply light JavaScript customization when needed.
  • Configure:
    • Forms
    • Plugins
    • Integrations
    • Tracking tools
    • Website widgets
  • Build reusable components and scalable CMS structures.

Website Performance & SEO

  • Optimize websites for:
    • Page speed
    • Mobile responsiveness
    • Accessibility
    • SEO
    • User experience
  • Implement on-page SEO fundamentals, including:
    • Metadata
    • Heading structures
    • Image optimization
    • Schema basics
  • Run performance audits using:
    • Google Lighthouse
    • PageSpeed Insights
    • GTmetrix
  • Identify and resolve issues affecting site performance and usability.

Testing, QA & Maintenance

  • Test websites across:
    • Desktop
    • Mobile
    • Tablets
    • Major browsers
  • Troubleshoot:
    • Responsive design issues
    • Formatting problems
    • Plugin conflicts
    • CMS issues
  • Manage routine website updates and maintenance.
  • Ensure websites remain stable, secure, and fully functional.

Marketing & Content Collaboration

  • Collaborate with marketing, content, and leadership teams.
  • Build landing pages supporting:
    • Lead generation
    • Marketing campaigns
    • Product launches
  • Implement stakeholder feedback quickly and accurately.
  • Maintain organized design assets and reusable website components.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You combine a strong visual design eye with technical website skills.
  • You understand both UI/UX and website implementation.
  • You can balance aesthetics with performance, SEO, and conversions.
  • You are highly detail-oriented and catch visual or responsive inconsistencies.
  • You can manage multiple website projects simultaneously.
  • You communicate clearly and work effectively with marketing and content teams.
  • You can work independently in a remote environment.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 2+ years of professional website design experience.
  • Strong proficiency with Figma, Adobe XD, or Sketch.
  • Hands-on experience with one or more of:
    • WordPress
    • Webflow
    • Shopify
    • Squarespace
  • Strong HTML and CSS skills.
  • Experience building responsive websites.
  • Experience optimizing websites for performance and mobile devices.
  • Strong understanding of modern website UI/UX principles.
  • Strong attention to detail and quality assurance.

Preferred Experience

  • Shopify or WooCommerce experience.
  • Basic JavaScript/front-end development knowledge.
  • Familiarity with:
    • Google Analytics
    • Google Tag Manager
    • SEO tools
  • Experience with SaaS, agencies, or e-commerce brands.
  • Landing page and conversion optimization experience.
  • Understanding of SEO-friendly website architecture.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may include:

  • Designing a new landing page in Figma.
  • Building approved designs in WordPress or Webflow.
  • Customizing layouts using HTML and CSS.
  • Optimizing website speed and mobile responsiveness.
  • Running Lighthouse or PageSpeed audits.
  • Testing pages across browsers and devices.
  • Implementing stakeholder revisions.
  • Supporting marketing campaigns with new website pages.
  • Troubleshooting CMS or formatting issues.

In short: you design and build visually polished, responsive, fast, and conversion-focused websites that support both user experience and business growth.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Website projects and updates delivered on time.
  • Strong mobile responsiveness across devices.
  • Improved Lighthouse and website performance scores.
  • Fast page-load performance.
  • Reduced website errors and formatting issues.
  • Positive stakeholder feedback on design and usability.
  • Improvements in SEO and conversion performance.

Interview Process

  1. Initial Phone Screen
  2. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  3. Portfolio Review & Practical Assessment
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer & Background Verification

Apply Now

If you’re a Website Designer who can both design and build, have hands-on experience with Figma, WordPress/Webflow, HTML/CSS, and care about creating fast, responsive, conversion-focused websites, we’d love to hear from you.

Job Description Summary
The Clinical Trial Leader -CTLs are accountable for the set-up, execution and delivery of their assigned trial(s) and contribute to delivery of client’s pipeline through accurate planning and efficient execution of trials that bring speed and value to participating subjects and sites. The CTL provides leadership and direction to the trial team (core and extended team members) and is accountable for the overall success and delivery of their assigned clinical trial according to defined milestones and key performance indicators. They are responsible for steering and directing clinical trial activities, including patient and site engagement activities, direct communication, and interaction with multiple internal and external stakeholders (e.g. investigative sites) and team members on a global, multi-country or regional basis. The CTL is responsible for managing the planning, implementation, and tracking of the clinical trial process as well as risk mitigation. The CTL serves as a proactive member of the clinical delivery team, liaising closely with the Clinical Trial Managers (“CTM”) on all study-related issues. As leader of the Trial Team, the CTL communicates trial status to stakeholders, escalating issues as appropriate.

Key Accountabilities:

Trial Preparation

  • Accountable for the accurate planning and operational feasibility of trial timelines; and oversight of trial preparation to ensure trial team members are aligned and on track. Supports development of trial level documents owned by other functions (e.g. Statistics, Data Management, Study Physician, Medical Writing, Site Monitoring)

  • Verifies and provides input into the country allocation and oversees trial feasibility

Trial Conduct

  • In collaboration with other functions, ensures budget oversight, including support of regular clinical quality monitoring, Safety Management Committee (SMC)/Data Management Committee (DMC) management and safety reporting

  • Prepare and implement amendments of core documents including training material updates/retraining as needed

  • Support authority/ethics responses to requests as applicable

  • Maintains oversight of outsourcing of vendor services (including central lab) in conjunction with other functions

  • Monitor progress of patient recruitment and accrual of endpoints and proactively update and action contingencies throughout trial conduct.

  • For early clinical trials, co-ordinates and harmonizes Innovation Unit tasks in a trial (e.g. biomarker sampling, genomics, sub-studies)

  • Embraces innovative technologies, as well as creates and maintains a culture that drives empowerment, smart risk taking and client’s CD&O identity

Compliance with Parexel standards

  • Update CV as required

Skills:

Dimensions of trial complexity include protocol, patients, sites, countries, vendors. Extensive experience in clinical trial project management in an international context.

Demonstrates leadership behaviors of supporting, connecting, and empowering teams, providing future direction, demonstrating visionary and innovative thinking and inspiring teams to achieve a common goal.
