jobs.title: Clinical Trial Quality Control Manager (Site Oversight) - Remote
jobs.excerpt: Primary Function:The Clinical QC Manager is a Clinical Operations–based role responsible for conducting independent quality control (QC) assessments to confirm that investigational sites are executing clinical trials in accordance with study protocols, GCP, and company procedures.
jobs.description:
Primary Function:

The Clinical QC Manager is a Clinical Operations–based role responsible for conducting independent quality control (QC) assessments to confirm that investigational sites are executing clinical trials in accordance with study protocols, GCP, and company procedures. This role performs targeted, risk‑based QC oversight through on‑site QC visits and focused documentation and process reviews to verify that critical study activities are being performed as intended.

Working in partnership with Clinical Trial Managers (CTMs), CRAs, and other Clinical Operations staff, the Clinical QC Manager independently assesses site execution and protocol adherence and collaborates with the study team on follow‑up actions. The role identifies protocol adherence gaps, recurring operational issues, and process risks, and supports timely follow‑up with accountable owners. This position does not replace routine monitoring activities or serve as the primary site management function; rather, it strengthens study execution by evaluating site processes, identifying trends, and supporting issue resolution across studies.

This position reports to the Executive Director, Head of US Clinical Operations, and is based remotely. Frequent travel to investigational sites is required to support on‑site QC visits and assessments.

Major Responsibilities and Duties:

QC Planning, Assessments, and Reporting

  • Develop and maintain study‑specific QC plans, updating based on study progress, complexity, and risk assessment.
  • Create and maintain QC tools (e.g., checklists, templates, trackers) to support consistent execution of QC activities.
  • Conduct risk‑based, on‑site QC visits to investigational sites to assess protocol adherence and execution of critical study processes (e.g., informed consent process checks, protocol‑required procedures, safety reporting processes, and essential document maintenance).
  • Conduct in‑house QC activities (remote or in‑office reviews) as needed, ensuring QC activities are completed within defined timelines and quality expectations.
  • Evaluate site processes and documentation to confirm studies are being conducted consistently and as intended.
  • Prepare clear, objective QC Visit Reports documenting scope, observations, trends, and required follow‑up actions.
  • Escalate significant compliance, patient safety, or data integrity concerns through defined Clinical Operations escalation pathways.

Issue Identification, Follow‑Up, and Trend Analysis

  • On a regular basis, in partnership with Clinical Operations teams, identify protocol deviations, recurring site‑level issues, and operational risks through QC activities.
  • Support study teams with root cause analysis (RCA) and contribute to the development of corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), as needed.
  • Track QC findings and follow‑up actions to closure and contribute to cross‑site and cross‑study trend analysis.

Inspection Readiness Support

  • Support inspection readiness activities across preparation, conduct, and follow‑up phases, including self‑checks and targeted readiness reviews.
  • Perform targeted reviews of site and study documentation as part of QC assessments to support ongoing inspection readiness.
  • Provide QC summaries and documentation to Clinical Operations leadership and study teams, as requested.

Training, Knowledge Sharing, and Operational Improvement

  • Contribute to training activities for Clinical Operations teams based on QC findings, common site execution gaps, and protocol adherence challenges.
  • Incorporate lessons learned from QC activities and regulatory inspections into training, guidance, and study team communications.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement based on QC observations and trends.
  • Support implementation of applicable SOPs and study processes by reinforcing procedural expectations and providing training or clarification on relevant procedures.

REQUIRED:

  • Bachelor’s degree in medical science or a related field, with five years’ experience in clinical research, including hands‑on experience with quality‑related activities, such as QC oversight and inspection‑related activities; or equivalent combination of higher education, training and experience.

PREFERRED:

  • Deep knowledge and understanding of clinical trial processes and quality management.
  • Strong working knowledge of ICH‑GCP as well as applicable regulations and guidelines.
  • Solid understanding of the skills and knowledge required to deliver a clinical study (e.g., international guidelines, study management, site management, and monitoring).
  • Strong communication and influencing skills: able to communicate effectively and concisely, clearly articulate viewpoints, and align with stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze, interpret, and resolve complex issues.
  • Ability to think strategically and objectively, demonstrating creativity, innovation, and sound judgment.
  • Demonstrated commitment to the highest standards of integrity and ethics.

The pay range for this position at commencement of employment is expected to be between $140 and $160K/year; however, base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a sign-on bonus, restricted stock units, and discretionary awards in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as vacation, sick time, and parental leave), dependent on the position offered. ABOUT SLATE

At Slate, we’re building safe, reliable vehicles that people can afford, personalize and love—and doing it here in the USA as part of our commitment to reindustrialization. The spirit of DIY and customization runs throughout every element of a Slate, because people should have control over how their trucks look, feel, and represent them.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We are seeking an Internal Audit Manager to help scale and coordinate our business process and IT audit activities across the enterprise. In this role, you will help build and oversee a team of audit professionals, drive the execution of our risk-based audit plan, and serve as a key partner to business and technology leaders in strengthening Slate Auto’s control environment. The ideal candidate brings a well-rounded audit background spanning both operational and IT controls, strong leadership capabilities, and a proactive mindset that aligns with our commitment to innovation, integrity, and operational excellence.

WHAT YOU GET TO DO

Audit Leadership & Planning

  • Assist in the development and execution of the annual, risk-based internal audit plan covering both business process and IT audit activities across the organization.

  • Lead and manage a team of Internal Auditors, providing day-to-day direction, coaching, and performance feedback to foster professional growth and high-quality audit delivery.

  • Coordinate audit resources and timelines to ensure audits are executed efficiently, on schedule, and in alignment with departmental and corporate objectives.

Business Process Audit Oversight

  • Oversee and actively participate in operational and financial audits spanning key business functions including Procurement, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Finance, and Sales.

  • Evaluate the design and operating effectiveness of process-level controls, identifying control gaps, inefficiencies, and opportunities for meaningful improvement.

  • Apply data analytics and process mapping techniques to assess risk, identify trends, and develop actionable recommendations that strengthen the overall control environment.

IT Audit Oversight

  • Oversee and actively participate in IT audits covering cybersecurity, infrastructure, system implementations, access management, and data governance.

  • Evaluate the design and operating effectiveness of IT general controls (ITGCs) and application controls across key business systems.

  • Ensure IT audit activities are aligned with business risk priorities and reflect current and emerging technology risks facing the organization.

SOX Compliance & Risk Management

  • Manage SOX compliance activities across both business process and IT control domains, including control design assessments, walkthroughs, and operating effectiveness testing.

  • Coordinate with Finance, IT, Operations, and external auditors to ensure SOX documentation and testing are completed accurately, on time, and in accordance with applicable standards.

  • Partner with business and technology leaders to ensure key financial and operational risks are understood and effectively mitigated.

Reporting & Executive Communication

  • Prepare and deliver clear, well-structured audit reports summarizing findings, risk implications, and actionable recommendations for both operational and executive-level audiences.

  • Present audit results to senior management and facilitate alignment on corrective action plans with business process owners and IT stakeholders.

Issue Remediation & Governance

  • Manage end-to-end oversight of corrective action plans, including progress tracking, stakeholder engagement, and escalation of overdue or high-risk items.

  • Validate the effectiveness of remediation efforts to ensure that control improvements are durable and sustainably embedded within business and technology processes.

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

  • Build trusted relationships across Finance, IT, Operations, Supply Chain, and Compliance to promote a culture of accountability, transparency, and continuous improvement.

  • Leverage data analytics tools such as Power BI and Tableau to enhance audit execution, surface deeper insights, and elevate the quality of audit reporting.

  • Stay current on emerging business and technology risks, evolving regulations, industry trends, and audit best practices.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TEAM

Nous recherchons des personnes très motivées et responsables qui souhaitent avoir la possibilité d’influencer l’entreprise et de faire partie de la solution. Chez IQVIA, nous recherchons des personnes qui mettent l’accent sur l’apprentissage continu et le développement de carrière.

Objectif :

Assister la direction du département dans le développement de la stratégie du département et la constitution de l’équipe; assurer un niveau élevé de service aux clients et développer des stratégies en accord avec les objectifs du département; gérer les relations clés avec les clients; servir d’expert dans l’alignement, la gestion et l’amélioration des relations avec les clients tout en gardant une vue d’ensemble du portefeuille de clients d’un point de vue opérationnel et financier. Communiquer avec les équipes de projet et le développement commercial afin de garantir une excellente prestation aux clients et la cohérence entre les études, y compris la gestion des relations et des portefeuilles, la mise en œuvre des meilleures pratiques, l’harmonisation et le développement de projets d’amélioration des performances spécifiques aux clients, et faciliter la gestion de la transmission à l’échelon supérieur.

RESPONSABILITÉS :

  • Assurer une qualité constante et exceptionnelle des produits livrés par le département.
  • Gérer les relations avec les clients et diriger les équipes afin d’atteindre avec succès les objectifs fixés par le client.
  • Gérer les procédures opérationnelles standard du département et veiller au respect des lignes directrices BPC de la CIH.
  • Superviser la maintenance, l’examen et la mise en œuvre des procédures de contrôle de la qualité.
  • Diriger les projets et les initiatives du département et de l’entreprise.
  • Procéder à la planification des capacités.
  • Assister l’équipe de développement commercial dans l’examen des demandes de propositions (RFP) et des demandes d’informations (RFI) pour les comptes attribués, en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les équipes internes et le client.

CONNAISSANCES, COMPÉTENCES ET APTITUDES REQUISES :

  • Connaissance des directives de la FDA (Food and Drug Administration) et de leur impact sur les opérations
  • Bonnes compétences en matière de gestion d’équipe
  • Bonne capacité à établir des priorités, à planifier et à organiser
  • Bonne capacité à résoudre les problèmes
  • Excellentes compétences en matière de service à la clientèle
  • Excellentes compétences en matière de communication et de relations interpersonnelles
  • Connaissance de base des ordinateurs; de préférence Microsoft Office Excel et Microsoft Office Word
  • Capacité à établir et à maintenir des relations de travail efficaces avec les collègues, les responsables et les clients

We work closely with technology partners and our sponsor partners to help speed therapies to market in a global network. Connectivity is one of Ventrata’s biggest growth levers. While our largest strategic integrations receive dedicated account coverage, our broader partner portfolio requires a scalable approach to onboarding, quality, adoption and growth.

That’s where you come in.

You’ll own this portfolio end to end, building programmes and processes that improve performance across many partners at once. You’ll have significant autonomy to prioritise opportunities, address risks and decide where your time will have the greatest commercial impact.

Your goals

  1. Grow GMV and booking volume across Ventrata’s broader connectivity portfolio.
  2. Improve integration health, capability adoption and adherence to Ventrata’s quality standards.
  3. Increase the efficiency and consistency of partner onboarding and certification.
  4. Strengthen Ventrata’s contribution to and leadership within the OCTO community.
  5. Help partners resolve more technical questions through clearer documentation and scalable self-service resources.

  • Manage Ventrata’s broader connectivity partner portfolio through scalable programmes including office hours, partner communications and regular health reviews.
  • Lead quality-gated onboarding from qualification and scoping through certification, documentation and launch.

Essa pessoa atuará em parceria com CRM, Marketing, Comercial, Produto, Ciência de Dados, Analytics, Canais e Tecnologia, contribuindo para transformar inteligência analítica em ações práticas que aumentem engajamento, conversão, retenção, rentabilização, penetração de produtos e valor de cliente.

Buscamos uma pessoa sênior, analítica, estratégica e orientada a impacto, capaz de atuar como parceira do negócio na identificação de oportunidades, priorização de ações e evolução da inteligência aplicada ao CRM PME.

Essa pessoa não será responsável por desenvolver modelos de NBO/NBA, mas terá papel essencial em conectar os modelos existentes à operação de CRM, transformando recomendações analíticas em hipóteses, testes, campanhas, jornadas e aprendizados acionáveis.

Esperamos alguém com profundidade analítica, visão de negócio e capacidade de influência para ajudar o time a adotar melhor o uso de inteligência nas comunicações, tornando as interações com clientes PME mais relevantes, personalizadas, mensuráveis e eficientes.

O que buscamos em você:

  • Domínio avançado de SQL para extração, tratamento, modelagem analítica e cruzamento de grandes volumes de dados.

Soft Skills

Diferenciais

Company: SecurityPal

Position: Customer Success Manager - Mid-Market

Reports to Position: Director of Customer Success

About SecurityPal

SecurityPal helps companies speed up complex security reviews so sales teams can close deals faster and security teams can stay focused on keeping systems safe. As companies struggle to protect their data, security reviews have become more frequent and time-consuming. We make the customer assurance process faster and easier.

Working at SecurityPal

We’re a fast-moving, collaborative team where impact matters more than tenure. You’ll have real ownership of your book of business, the chance to grow quickly, and the support of people who care deeply about our customers’ success.

We value curiosity, urgency, and a growth mindset. Our industry is constantly evolving, and we’re committed to learning and adapting every day to stay ahead.

Overview: SecurityPal Engagement Management

The Engagement Management team is responsible for managing our customers' journey with SecurityPal. This journey consists of 4 major stages:

  • Onboarding our customers onto the SecurityPal ecosystem
  • Driving adoption of our software and services
  • Supporting customers’ growth and maturity as trusted business partners
  • Renewing and expanding our partnership

Essential Functions:

To excel in this role, Engagement Managers must:

  • Skillfully manage the needs of a portfolio of approximately 50 medium-value customers
  • Manage the end-to-end customer journey - from onboarding to renewal
  • Build strong relationships with customers - from entry-level sales team members to C-suite executives
  • Actively assess and address customer health and churn risks
  • Demonstrate technical aptitude to quickly learn and enable customers about our app product
  • Possess strong project management skills to oversee customer projects executed by our delivery team
  • Have a commitment to continuous improvement and help identify and enhance tools and processes to deliver a better customer experience

Interests and Skills:

High performers at our organization are:

  • Comfortable in an ever-changing environment
  • Independent workers, comfortable owning a book of business
  • Team players with a strong desire for personal growth
  • Highly organized in managing and executing complex customer tasks
  • Excellent communicators
  • Relationship builders with a sales mindset
  • Tech-savvy and interested in AI, enterprise software, and information security

Prerequisite Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent
  • Demonstrated history of performance in a startup environment
  • 2+ years of experience in professional services, customer success, project management, sales, consulting, and/or similar roles

SecurityPal is an equal opportunity employer.

Role Title: Voice Recorder (French + English)

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging with French bilingual speakers to contribute to a customer's audio project focused on advancing machine learning. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

Scope of Work

  1. Record high-quality audio clips in both French and English, following provided scripts and prompts.
  2. Listen to and evaluate audio samples, providing accurate feedback on clarity and intelligibility.
  3. Create recordings in diverse settings, such as a stationary car or quiet office, to offer realistic environmental data.
  4. Generate background noises (e.g., rustling papers, tapping surfaces) as requested, ensuring all sounds are captured safely and clearly.
  5. Adhere to project guidelines concerning data privacy, safety, and specific recording requirements.
  6. Accurately document and submit each completed audio file with all necessary metadata.
  7. Collaborate remotely with project coordinators to address feedback and ensure deliverables meet technical standards.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Native-level proficiency in French, with strong command of spoken and written language.
  2. At least B2-level proficiency in English, with clear verbal and written communication skills.
  3. Prior experience with audio recording or voice-over is advantageous.
  4. Comfort working independently and adhering to precise technical guidelines.
  5. Exceptional attention to detail for both production quality and documentation.
  6. Ability to generate authentic background sounds as directed.
  7. Familiarity with remote collaboration tools and digital file submission platforms.

AI agents are rapidly transforming how enterprises operate, accelerating productivity, automating workflows, and enabling new business models. At the same time, they introduce a new security challenge: agents execute through human and machine identities, inheriting permissions that grant access to sensitive enterprise data. Traditional identity security was designed to govern who can access resources, not how autonomous agents use that access at machine speed.

We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Director of Product Marketing to define the go-to-market strategy, messaging, and positioning for Cyera's Identity Security solutions. In this role, you will partner closely with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success to establish Cyera's leadership at the intersection of identity, data, and AI security. The ideal candidate has deep expertise in identity security, a strong understanding of modern AI architectures and non-human identities, and a passion for translating complex technical capabilities into compelling customer narratives that drive market adoption.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Develop and execute the go-to-market strategy for the Cyera’s Identity Security solution.
  • Own the strategic storytelling for Cyera's Identity Security portfolio, crafting compelling messaging that differentiates Cyera in the market.
  • Define category-defining narratives that position Cyera at the convergence of identity, data, and AI security.
  • Translate complex technical capabilities into compelling customer stories that resonate with executive and technical audiences.
  • Partner with product management to translate technical capabilities into customer-centric benefits.
  • Create high-impact sales enablement materials, including presentations, case studies, whitepapers, and battle cards.
  • Conduct market research to understand customer pain points, competitive landscape, and industry trends.
  • Collaborate with demand generation and digital marketing teams to develop campaigns that drive awareness and lead generation.
  • Serve as a thought leader, contributing to blog posts, webinars, videos, and industry events.
  • Monitor and measure the success of product marketing initiatives, using data-driven insights to optimize strategies.

Requirements

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 7+ years of product marketing experience in cybersecurity, identity security, AI security, or adjacent enterprise security markets.
  • Deep understanding of identity security, including human and non-human identities, identity governance, privileged access, and modern identity architectures.
  • Understanding of AI, data security, and the convergence of identity, data, and AI security.
  • Proven ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, customer-focused messaging.

jobs.description:
About Get Covered and Revyse

Revyse helps multifamily operators discover the best vendor partners, manage contracts and compliance, and reduce financial risk. Our AI-powered platform helps the multifamily industry turn vendor data into a strategic advantage. We are a fast-paced post-acquisition startup with a big vision. Founded by industry experts and financially supported by industry veterans, we’re overhauling the relationship between operators and suppliers in multifamily.

About the role

We’re hiring a Program Manager, Risk and Compliance to optimize the compliance engine behind our Vendor Credentialing product. You’ll assess and update the frameworks and workflows that help Revyse customers enforce and track their risk and insurance standards for vendors. You’ll play a central role in translating customer requirements into actionable, scalable processes, making vendor credentialing simpler, smarter, and more transparent across the portfolio.

This isn’t a customer onboarding role, a product manager role, or an account manager role. Instead, you’ll be one of our internal risk management experts and insurance subject matter experts. As a strategic IC, you’re someone who knows how to make a risk management process run smoothly without owning every piece of the process. You’ll work closely with our Ops, Implementation, Product, and CX teams to bring it all together. You understand the difference between occurrence vs. claims-made coverage, can explain why a CG 20 10 matters, and know when a CG 20 37 is actually better for the client. If you just nodded knowingly, keep reading.

What you'll do

  • Update and inform systems to evaluate vendors according to each client’s risk tiers, insurance requirements, and compliance policies.
  • Translate customer-driven risk and insurance requirements into effective platform rules, workflows, and communications.
  • Develop reusable templates, policies, endorsement libraries, and guides for both internal teams and Revyse customers, always aligning with customer-specified standards.
  • Help optimize requirements and workflows to ensure vendors meet the standards set by our clients.
  • Track, document, and report on compliance with customer-defined insurance requirements for each vendor type.
  • Review exception requests for insurance requirements, documenting repetitious risk acceptance decisions, and suggesting updates to customer requirements to streamline vendor approvals.
  • Facilitate and support the client’s exception review process, ensuring all documentation is captured and decisions are logged per client policy.
  • Collaborate with our Services Team to ensure smooth vendor enrollment and review of requirements.
  • Provide tools, playbooks, and best practices that make it easier for property teams to monitor and enforce their standards.
  • Review and analyze vendor agreements to ensure customer-required risk provisions (like insurance, indemnity, or hold harmless) are clearly reflected.
  • Collaborate with customer’s legal counsel to negotiate favorable contract terms that align with risk management objectives.
  • Establish protocols for reviewing and approving non-standard vendor agreement terms.
  • Ensure vendor agreements and provisions comply with regulatory requirements and state-specific requirements for work such as construction, maintenance, and service contracts.
  • Partner with CX, Product, and Ops to ensure platform logic and communications reflect client standards.
  • Serve as an internal subject matter expert on vendor credentialing and insurance requirements, providing support to both customers and internal teams.
  • Help educate property managers and vendors on best practices, requirements, and process updates.
  • Work with insurance carriers to streamline certificate of insurance (COI) verification processes.
  • Present risk metrics and vendor compliance trends to executive leadership.
  • Support sales teams with risk management expertise during client presentations and RFP responses.
  • Analyze data to recommend enhancements to workflows, rules, or resources that make it easier for clients to manage risk.
  • Develop regular reports on vendor compliance rates, exception trends, and exposure metrics, aligned to client requirements.
  • Analyze vendor incident data to identify patterns requiring policy or process adjustments.
  • Establish benchmarking metrics for vendor risk management across the portfolio.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years in commercial insurance with hands-on experience in one or more: commercial lines brokerage, risk management, insurance compliance, or contractor/vendor credentialing - ideally serving property management, construction, or real estate clients, active P&C License.
  • You've personally reviewed hundreds (if not thousands) of certificates of insurance and can spot issues like missing additional insured endorsements, inadequate limits, or improper waiver of subrogation language in seconds.
  • Deep knowledge of commercial insurance products and coverages - general liability, workers' compensation, professional liability, umbrella/excess, auto liability, etc. You understand what's required, why it matters, and how to explain it to non-insurance professionals.
  • Proficiency in risk assessment frameworks (as implemented for client policies), credentialing or contract management platforms, and insurance certificate tracking.
  • Experience supporting or implementing risk management frameworks for enterprise clients.
  • Experience designing repeatable, documented processes for high-compliance or regulated workflows.
  • Strong written communication skills. You’ll be drafting guides, rules, and process docs constantly.
  • A calm, confident approach to solving problems in messy, high-urgency situations.
  • Strong strategic thinking and analytical skills, with the ability to execute in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. You can identify what needs to be done, and then you can get it done. Easy-peasy.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a willingness to roll up your sleeves and take complete ownership of initiatives in a startup environment. We know that startups aren’t everyone’s cup of tea, but if it's yours, let’s talk!

Why Join Team Revyse: for insurance professionals; this is your chance to leverage your technical expertise at scale. Instead of managing one client portfolio, you'll build systems that help hundreds of property management companies improve their vendor risk management.

jobs.excerpt: Our Mission & Strategy: At Pfizer, we apply science and our global resources to bring therapies to people that aim to extend and significantly improve their lives.
jobs.description:
Our Mission & Strategy:

At Pfizer, we apply science and our global resources to bring therapies to people that aim to extend and significantly improve their lives. For 175 years, patients have trusted Pfizer to discover, develop, and deliver medical breakthroughs that change patients’ lives. Today, we collaborate with patients and patient advocates to help develop breakthrough treatments and innovative approaches to address patient challenges. These partnerships have helped to increase patient engagement in research and development, diversify clinical trials, develop patient-friendly educational materials and patient support programs, and elevate priority policy and social impact issues. To support Pfizer’s vision for its immunoglobulin (Ig) portfolio to transform the lives of people living with rare autoimmune conditions like Chronic Inflammatory Demyelinating Polyneuropathy (CIDP), through innovative treatments and comprehensive care solutions, the Pfizer Specialty Care Patient Solutions team is building an innovative patient advocacy support program for the strong Ig portfolio to compliantly and tactically support patient journeys.

Job Brief:

Pfizer Specialty Care Patient Solutions is seeking a compassionate, strategic, and organized Community Navigator (CN) to join our U.S. Patient Engagement Team, with primary responsibility for supporting patients and caregivers across the East U.S. territory. The CN will serve as a guide for Immunoglobulin (Ig) patients through their healthcare journey by providing fit-for-purpose education and navigation resources to help ensure they understand the treatment landscape and available resources. The CN will also be fully and appropriately integrated into Pfizer’s current cross-functional ecosystem ensuring that all patients can receive the appropriate support resources they want and need. The CN will compliantly triage patients as appropriate to applicable reimbursement support resources.

This role provides education and navigation support only and does not provide medical advice, clinical decision‑making, or reimbursement case management. The Community Navigator operates within defined compliance guardrails and triage pathways, partnering with Medical, Access, and Patient Support teams as appropriate.

The CN role is a field-based community-facing colleague for individuals living with chronic inflammatory demyelinating polyneuropathy (CIDP) and their caregivers, with a focus on East U.S. communities and regional support needs. The primary function of the CN is to compliantly educate patients on the disease landscape and other patient support programs that may be available through Pfizer. The CN will be the single point of contact with the patient and will function as a liaison to either provide patients with internal or external resources. The CN role reports directly to the National Patient Engagement Director - Ig.

The objectives of the Patient Navigator (CN) role are:

  • Patient Education and Support: The CN longitudinally educates patients and caregivers about disease state awareness, treatment preparation and expectations, local and regional support offerings, health, and wellness resources within a patient’s community, as well as appropriate triage to available resources at Pfizer.
  • Patient Navigation: The CN assists patients in navigating their overall care and local support systems across diagnosis, treatment initiation, and ongoing therapy by connecting them to appropriate local, regional, and Pfizer resources. The CN does not assist with reimbursement support for patients prescribed Pfizer’s Ig therapies.
  • Collaboration: The CN closely and compliantly coordinates with the IG Advocacy Lead, Specialty Infusion Pharmacies (SIPs) Account Directors, FAS, Sales, and Field Medical along with other cross-functional partners to ensure that the integrated patient offerings align with intended support and educational objectives in the context of local market dynamics and longitudinal patient journeys

Why Patients Need You:

  • Individuals living with conditions treated with Ig therapies like CIDP, and their caregivers may face various challenges in diagnosis, understanding treatments options, obtaining, and maintaining treatments.
  • Proper disease education and awareness can equip patients to have the appropriate discussions with their healthcare providers.
  • Particularly in CIDP with new emerging therapies, patients need to understand the treatment options from Pfizer that they can then discuss with their healthcare providers to determine what is best for them.
  • The CN is the central point of contact for patients and caregivers and focused on disease state awareness, education, support resources, and resources along the disease and treatment journey and connects patients to other resources inside and outside of Pfizer as well as other local health and wellness resources in their local community.

What You Will Achieve:

  • Provide education and guidance to resources for patients to address their questions and need for information.
  • Assist patients in navigating their overall care – via educating and connecting patients to appropriate resources.
  • Share educational resources on emerging treatments, shared decision making and what patients can expect across the treatment journey.
  • Closely coordinates with the APR, attending PAG events within geography to present RC approved education on treatment options​.
  • Through use of motivational interviewing, identify specific patient needs and goals to drive tailored and appropriate engagement with patients / caregivers over time.
  • For opted-in patients, provides in-person and virtual 1:1 engagement through a defined communication strategy and purposeful use of a curated menu of print and digital resources based on the patient/caregiver’s individual journey:
  • Build trust and provide ongoing support resources for the patient to take the next best action.
  • Provide educational materials / resources about CIDP or treatments.
  • Connect patients / caregivers with local health & wellness resources through referrals to local organizations.
  • Appropriately provide patients with educational support throughout the entire treatment journey as appropriate

How You Will Have Impact:

  • The CN will be located within the East U.S. geography / region and will assist patients in navigating their overall care – via educating and connecting patients to appropriate healthcare resources.
  • Understands and complies with all relevant regulations and policies. All activities to be executed in close collaboration with legal and compliance to ensure that they are implemented in a thoughtful and compliant manner that meets Pfizer’s high standards of conduct.
  • Deliver overview of Ig CN role and Pfizer’s patient support resources to patients and caregivers at various Pfizer-sponsored events (e.g., in-person/virtual booth exhibits) at local, regional, and national levels.
  • Partners with the Cross Functional Teams to meet the needs of patients and caregivers through providing educational content and resources to local support groups.
  • Engage with opted-in patients / caregivers in a mutually agreed upon manner (e.g., phone calls, emails, texts, in-person, etc.)
  • Compliantly collaborate with cross-functional partners to ensure that the integrated patient-support resources align with intended objectives in the context of local market dynamics.
  • Operate within defined compliance guardrails and appropriate triage and escalation pathways when partnering with Medical, Access, or other Patient-facing / Patient-supporting roles.
  • Provide aggregated local insights to inform Rare Disease Team on the development of educational materials for patient engagement and patient support resources that fill needs within the patient community.
  • Compliantly schedule and organize travel in a timely, thorough manner and order all required materials for local, regional, and national events

Outcome:

  • The CN will work toward defined measurable goals of patient engagement, education delivery, and program impact, shared across cross-functional teams, as appropriate.
  • Held accountable to CN established goals.

Basic Qualifications

  • B.S. or B.A. Degree is required.
  • Minimum 8 years pharmaceutical industry or related experience - preferably in Rare Autoimmune Diseases
  • Experience in demonstrating exceptional communication, listening, and platform trained speakers.
  • Demonstrated ability to work in a highly regulated environment and adhere to strict company compliance guidelines and procedures.
  • Proven track record of collaborating broadly with a diverse range of customers, clients, and stakeholders.
  • Experience in responsible business practices and compassionate communication both written and spoken.
  • Understands and navigates Pfizer and industry compliance guidelines aligned to working with FMD (Medical), and Access & Reimbursement colleagues.
  • Ability to deliver meaningful & concise presentations with integrity and empathy.
  • Strong attention to detail, organizational and business skills
  • Ability to travel at a minimum of 50%; scope of events is primarily on weekends and evenings

Preferred Knowledge & Skill Sets Desired

  • Clinical background is highly preferred (i.e., RN, APRN, NP, ARNP, ACSW, LCSW, MPH)
  • Extensive knowledge of rare autoimmune diseases like CIDP, PI, and DM, and the associated Rare Disease communities
  • Remote / Field based, must reside within the East U.S. territory.
  • Proficiency with CRM tools (e.g., POLARIS CRM)

Additional Details:

Last date to apply: August 18th, 2026

The annual base salary for this position ranges from $162,900.00 to $271,500.00. In addition, this position is eligible for participation in Pfizer’s Global Performance Plan with a bonus target of 20.0% of the base salary and eligibility to participate in our share based long term incentive program. We offer comprehensive and generous benefits and programs to help our colleagues lead healthy lives and to support each of life’s moments. Benefits offered include a 401(k) plan with Pfizer Matching Contributions and an additional Pfizer Retirement Savings Contribution, paid vacation, holiday and personal days, paid caregiver/parental and medical leave, and health benefits to include medical, prescription drug, dental and vision coverage. Educational qualifications

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently are essential.

Technical Skills (Essential)

Additional requirements

jobs.excerpt: About Us Founded in Montreal in 2018, nesto is a Canadian fintech company on a mission to make property financing positive, empowering, and transparent from start to finish.
jobs.description:
About Us

Founded in Montreal in 2018, nesto is a Canadian fintech company on a mission to make property financing positive, empowering, and transparent from start to finish. We began as a digital mortgage broker and became Canada's leading direct-to-consumer online lending platform. Through Nesto Cloud, our B2B, cloud-native, end-to-end mortgage technology platform, we empower financial institutions, credit unions, and commercial real estate lenders with intelligent automation, real-time compliance, and seamless integrations across the full lending lifecycle. Together with CMLS Financial, we form the Nesto Group: more than $73 billion CAD in residential and commercial mortgages under management, 1,300+ team members, 12 offices across Canada.

Our Track Record

  • Hypergrowth: Deloitte Fast 50 – 3 years in a row
  • Tech community credibility: TechTO Canadian Rocketship 2025
  • Industry leadership: CLA Lending Company of the Year – 4 consecutive years
  • Talent magnet: CMP Top Mortgage Employer 2025

Why Join Us

The mortgage industry runs on legacy systems, slow processes, and information nobody can see. We are changing that by building better technology. nesto is a place for builders, problem-solvers, and curious minds – people who move fast, embrace innovation, and believe we're stronger together. This is the place for you if you trust your skills and want to build technology that reshapes an entire industry. An entrepreneurial culture built on trust, speed, uncomfortable ambition, being stronger together, and a relentless obsession with our clients. We also do not think building with AI belongs to engineers. Every function here is expected to automate its own repetitive work, and you will have support to do it.

Work Location and Time Zone

This is a remote-first role open to candidates anywhere in Canada. We strongly prefer candidates who can work Eastern Time hours. If you are based elsewhere in Canada and have worked Eastern hours before, we still want to hear from you.

Why This Role Exists

We're delivering major platform programs for our large enterprise partners. This role is focused on building automation coverage for these initiatives, shaping end-to-end quality as the programs scale.

We already have a strong automation suite and deep in-house expertise at the staff level. This is not a rebuild from zero. It's about taking what works, adapting it to a platform being reshaped for these programs, and wiring it into CI/CD so quality keeps pace with delivery speed. We move fast and iterate, but we don't ship manual workarounds – we invest in repeatable, scalable structure.

You'd be the automation specialist within our delivery team, working closely with our staff automation developers as expert sounding boards, setting the approach and advising us on how this should be done. You can expect roughly a 80/20 split between hands-on coding and collaboration, depending on the project stage.

What Success Looks Like

  • Within 90 days, a working test automation framework is running, with 60–80% of critical test scenarios automated, running, and actively relied on by the team.
  • Within six months, automation runs in the CI/CD pipeline on pull requests, mirroring what exists for our core platform.
  • You've adapted and extended the existing automation framework rather than rebuilding from scratch – leveraging the suite and expertise already in place.
  • You make sure quality is understood beyond sprint-by-sprint testing, with a focus on ensuring all the pieces work together end to end.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Architect, build, and maintain scalable automated test suites in Playwright, using design patterns that keep them maintainable over time.
  • Partner with architects, developers, product managers, and our Staff QA Automation Developers across the SDLC – to clarify requirements and define clear acceptance criteria early, and to raise QA practices across the organization.
  • Drive quality across UI and API testing, using monitoring signals, incident reviews, and customer feedback to find improvements.
  • Work with Delivery leadership, stakeholders, and partners to prioritize automation coverage.
  • Integrate automated testing into the CI/CD pipeline so coverage runs continuously.
  • Work with product managers to define comprehensive test plans from product and design specifications (URDs, PRDs, HLDs).
  • Play a key role in supporting User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for key projects, for example when we integrate new partners or clients.
  • Leverage AI to speed up how you build and maintain automated tests, then share what works with the team.
  • Own quality beyond test execution – improve processes, documentation, and team workflows, and standardize what works into repeatable practices.
  • Review and run manual test cases in our test management tooling, validate features against test plans, and fold the right scenarios into the automated regression suite.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of QA experience testing SaaS or cloud applications, with a deep understanding of the full SDLC and how Quality Engineering fits into development.
  • 2+ years of hands-on test automation framework experience with Playwright, Cypress, or similar, including authoring and maintaining end-to-end (E2E) test suites.
  • A strong background in TypeScript and/or Go is required, and experience with MySQL or similar relational databases is a plus.
  • An automation-first track record: automated coverage over manual-only QA, with reliability built into the CI/CD pipeline rather than bolted on.
  • Full-stack testing across UI and API layers, including API validation with tools like Postman.
  • Test architecture and scalable design expertise, using patterns such as Page Object Model, data factories, and separation of concerns.
  • Agile fluency, comfort with rapid release cycles, and familiarity with test management platforms like Allure TestOps.
  • Initiative and a point of view. You arrive with a plan rather than waiting to be told what to do.

Nice-to-Have

  • Hands-on AI initiative: you have built agents or applications that made testing meaningfully faster
  • You turn requirements into genuinely useful test coverage, not checkbox test cases
  • Experience with MySQL or similar relational databases
  • Familiarity with test management platforms like Allure TestOps
  • Experience in SaaS, fintech, banking, insurance, or other financial services environments

This Role Might Fit You If

  • You have stood up automation from nothing on a program already in flight, and found that energizing rather than daunting
  • You would rather adapt and evolve a working system than rebuild it to your own taste
  • You are comfortable telling leadership "here is what we should do and here is how" early on, not a year in
  • You enjoy being in the room with business and delivery people, not only engineers, and can explain why a test gap matters in business terms
  • You want to shape quality strategy, not only write test code

What This Role Is Not

  • This is not a heads-down coding role. If you want to stay out of product and business conversations, this will frustrate you.
  • This is not a role focused mainly on executing manual test cases.
  • This is not a role for someone who prefers a reactive, waterfall approach and waits for development to finish before getting involved.
  • This is not a role for someone who prefers to work in isolation and doesn't want to improve broader team workflows, documentation, or quality processes.
  • This is not a role for someone who isn't ready to bring AI tools into their daily work.


Interview Process

  • Recruiter Screen (30 min): An intro call to learn about your background and give you a real picture of the role.
  • Discovery Call (45 min): A conversation with the hiring manager to dig into your experience and assess mutual fit.
  • Take-Home Assignment: A chance to showcase your skills through a practical exercise relevant to the role.
  • Case Study Interview (60 min): A deep dive into your submission, with time to get to know some team members and ask about the role and company.
  • Final Interview (60 min): You'll meet with the recruiter and two additional stakeholders for a final conversation before a decision is made.
  • Offer Stage: Pending successful background, criminal, and reference checks, you'll receive a formal offer to join the team.


What We Offer

  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Top-tier extended health, dental, and vision coverage, featuring 100% drug coverage.
  • Health & Wellness Spending Account: A $1,500 combined annual flex fund for things like gym memberships or extra medical needs.
  • Generous Paid Time Off: 4 weeks of vacation plus 8 personal floater days.
  • Retirement Savings: Access to a group RRSP/DPSP plan featuring competitive company-matching contributions.
  • Telemedicine Services: Access via Dialogue and coverage for licensed practitioner services.
  • Family Support: Robust Maternity and Parental Leave Top-Up programs.

Diversity and Inclusion
At nesto, we believe that creativity and collaboration are the result of a diverse team. We are committed to fostering a culture of diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging, and we strongly encourage women, people of color, LGBTQIA+ individuals, and individuals with disabilities to apply. Join us to do the best work of your career, solving meaningful problems with remarkable teams.

Greenhouse is looking for an Enterprise Account Manager to join our team!

Our Account Management team drives customer retention, growth and expansion opportunities, as well as continued product optimization and adoption. As an Enterprise Account Manager, you will own the renewals and upselling of new products into our rapidly growing ecosystem of customers. You will ensure a premium experience for our customers by understanding their core business objectives and motivating change in their organization. In addition, you’ll partner with our Customer Success, Marketing, Product and Finance teams to streamline workflows and communication processes within Greenhouse.

Who will love this job:

  • A strategic hunter - you thrive in a dynamic environment, and clearly see the full picture of an account, always recommending the best solutions that drive value for both customers and Greenhouse revenue
  • A thoughtful mediator - you're consultative and receptive under pressure, and you can build and defend a pricing structure on the spot rather than just smoothing the conversation over
  • A collaborative teammate - you love working with others and rely on strong partnerships to achieve the best outcomes for our customers
  • A builder and problem solver - you’re not afraid to test, iterate, and chip in ideas when it comes to solutions. You leverage AI tools to create custom workflows and streamline tasks. You can roll with the punches and adapt, and are excited to be a part of the solution

  • Effectively manage a book of business consisting of our most strategic accounts
  • Build, present, and defend data-backed pricing structures directly with procurement and finance stakeholders, driving alignment across broader buyer groups to close deals

  • Maintain an active pipeline of forecasted renewals and expansions to meet quota objectives
  • Partner with Customer Success Managers and leverage product expertise to solution for customer pain points
  • Position yourself as a strategic partner to key stakeholders and champions within named accounts
  • Diagnose and clearly mitigate churn risks, owning resolution strategies and advising sales leadership on ideal resolutions wherever appropriate
  • Be an active participant in building and improving internal operational processes
  • Travel occasionally to on-site client meetings, industry events and conferences, internal sales kick-offs, etc.
  • Additional projects and responsibilities as business needs require

You should have:

  • Several years of demonstrated experience in account expansion and renewals working with executive collaborators within Enterprise accounts (1,000+ employees)
  • A consistent track record of meeting or exceeding quotas
  • Excellent project management skills
  • The ability to construct, present, and defend complex pricing structures directly with procurement and finance, not just manage the relationships around them
  • Proven ability to solve complex problems through a consultative approach, effectively managing customer expectations while navigating challenges often outside of your direct control
  • Mastery in lifecycle revenue management, delivering high-accuracy forecasting for both renewals and expansion within a complex enterprise portfolio
  • Experience acting as a strategic advisor to senior leadership by synthesizing portfolio data into actionable insights regarding market themes, risk mitigation strategies, and growth opportunities
  • Experience with HR industry and SaaS, a plus
  • Your own unique talents! Your background has given you a unique perspective and set of transferable skills that aren't always in alignment with a given role - but those are qualities we value at Greenhouse. If you don't meet 100% of the qualifications outlined above, we still strongly encourage you to apply

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

Additionally, certain roles have the opportunity to receive sales commissions that are based on the terms of the sales commission plan applicable to the role.

For US-based employees, we offer short-term and long-term disability coverage, a 401(k) plan and company match. U.S. based employees also receive, per calendar year, up to 14 scheduled paid holidays and up to 80 hours of paid sick leave. Non-exempt employees accrue up to 20-25 days of paid vacation time annually, depending on tenure, and exempt employees have flexible paid time off (PTO).

Who we are

At Greenhouse, we live by our mission through using our own product to help us hire the right person for the job, every time. We’re committed to designing and responsibly using AI tools to transform how we work while keeping people at the center. We are a remote-first company and have shared office spaces in New York City and Ireland, and optional co-working spaces that give us flexibility to do our best work anywhere. We take an active role in our growth through a performance review program that’s committed to providing actionable feedback, and a bonus structure that rewards great performance. We believe that bringing together a variety of perspectives makes us a stronger company – and we nurture leaders who create an inclusive culture and invest into employee resource groups that celebrate our differences and life experiences. We’re proud to have built an award-winning culture that’s been recognized as Fortune’s Best Places to Work and Inc.’s Best Workplaces multiple years in a row.

This is a mid-senior project management role that combines strong technical project management expertise with strategic thinking, stakeholder engagement, and a strong understanding of how strategic communications, campaigns, and programmes are delivered. You will partner with programme teams and work across digital, insights, analytics, operations, and leadership functions to translate strategic objectives into clear delivery plans, align diverse stakeholders, and drive coordinated execution.

Success in this role requires more than managing timelines and deliverables. You will help teams navigate complexity, create clarity in ambiguous situations, facilitate decision-making, identify risks and opportunities, and enable cross-functional teams to deliver meaningful outcomes.

As a senior member of the Project Management Unit (PMU), you will support complex initiatives, strengthen organisational ways of working, mentor others where appropriate, and contribute to the ongoing evolution of project management practice across Meliore.

How you'll contribute

Partner with teams to deliver strategic communications campaigns
  • Partner with programme teams to translate strategic objectives into clear delivery approaches and actionable plans.
  • Work collaboratively across communications, digital, insights, analytics, operations, and leadership teams to coordinate delivery and drive alignment.
  • Support complex projects operating in fast-moving and often ambiguous environments.
  • Balance structure, governance, and accountability with the flexibility required for effective campaign delivery.
  • Develop project approaches, governance frameworks, delivery plans, reporting mechanisms, and project documentation.
  • Monitor progress, manage risks, dependencies, issues, and resources, adapting plans as priorities evolve.
  • Ensure projects are delivered against agreed objectives, timelines, budgets, and quality standards.

Facilitate collaboration and decision-making
  • Build trusted relationships across teams, functions, regions, and seniority levels.
  • Facilitate project planning, prioritisation, workshops, problem-solving, and decision-making processes.
  • Align diverse stakeholders around shared objectives and navigate competing priorities to maintain delivery momentum.
  • Communicate project status, risks, decisions, and recommendations clearly to stakeholders.
Strengthen organisational delivery
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of project management frameworks, tools, systems, and ways of working.
  • Capture and share lessons learned to strengthen organisational capability and improve future delivery.
  • Mentor, coach, and line manage junior project management staff, supporting their professional development and application of best practice.
  • Contribute to the ongoing development of the Project Management Unit and the evolution of project management practice across Meliore.

Our ideal candidate has

  • Previous experience of 5+ years as a Project Manager or Project Coordinator.
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder projects from initiation through to completion.
  • Strong technical project management expertise, with experience applying and adapting project management methodologies to different delivery contexts.
  • Experience supporting strategic communications, advocacy, campaigning, or other mission-driven programmes.
  • Excellent stakeholder engagement, facilitation, and relationship management skills, with the ability to influence without formal authority.
  • Proven ability to navigate ambiguity, balance competing priorities, and create clarity in complex environments.
  • Experience managing project governance, risks, dependencies, budgets, and resources.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience working across cultures, time zones, and multidisciplinary teams to deliver shared outcomes.
  • A collaborative, proactive, and solutions-oriented mindset, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
  • Fluency in written and spoken English (our working language). Additional languages are an advantage.
  • Professional project management certification (e.g. PMP, PRINCE2 Practitioner, DASM, or equivalent) is strongly preferred.

Why join us?

  • Be part of a remote-first, international network of professionals working on climate, energy and nature and work with a bunch of dynamic, culturally diverse individuals who combine their passion to make a difference with a rigorous and results-oriented approach to work.
  • 6 offline days (with no calls or meetings) per year to focus on your work
  • Reduced working time on Fridays during the Dry Season (summer)
  • Access to our employee assistance program to support your mental health and personal development
  • Supplementary paid business closure for end-of-year holidays
  • Maternity leave matched to 20 weeks for countries where regulation allows less than that
  • Enjoy regular opportunities to connect and collaborate with colleagues around the world
  • A full-time position with an employment or consultant contract, subject to location, for 12 months, with possible renewal after one year.
Location: Europe - Belgium, Denmark, Italy, Netherlands, Spain, UK.
We may be able to provide co-working spaces in some locations. Only candidates with the right to work in their location will be considered.

Contract and Benefits disclaimer: Contract type and some benefits may vary by jurisdiction. We will confirm eligibility and the applicable terms during the hiring process.

Salary / Fee: Meliore sets compensation levels through a systematic alignment with local market data, taking into account the responsibility level of each role or the expected level of services and the skills and experience of the selected candidate. We apply a consistent, equitable, compensation policy, and provide data on our calculations and pay or fee ranges, in all locations where we operate. Our compensation practices reflect our commitment to fairness, inclusion, and accountability, and are regularly reviewed to ensure alignment with evolving market standards and organisational values.

At DraftKings, AI is becoming an integral part of both our present and future, powering how work gets done today, guiding smarter decisions, and sparking bold ideas. It’s transforming how we enhance customer experiences, streamline operations, and unlock new possibilities. Our teams are energized by innovation and readily embrace emerging technology. We’re not waiting for the future to arrive. We’re shaping it, one bold step at a time. To those who see AI as a driver of progress, come build the future together.

The Crown Is Yours

As Director of Procurement, you'll lead a team responsible for procurement strategy supporting Technology & Product. You will partner with senior leaders to develop commercial strategies that support product innovation, platform scalability, operational resilience, and responsible technology investment. By connecting technology roadmaps, consumption insights, and market intelligence, you'll help teams move quickly while delivering measurable value and improving business outcomes.

What You'll Do

  • Lead and develop a team of Procurement professionals supporting Technology & Product, setting clear priorities, building category expertise, and fostering a high-performance culture.

  • Own the procurement strategy, supplier ecosystem, and sourcing roadmap across enterprise software, SaaS, cloud and infrastructure, hardware, telecom, data, AI, developer tools, cybersecurity, and technology services.

  • Partner with executive and senior leaders across Technology, Product, Engineering, Data, Information Security, IT, Finance, and Legal to align procurement strategies with product roadmaps, architecture decisions, investment priorities, and growth plans.

  • Lead complex sourcing initiatives and negotiations, including strategic software renewals, cloud and consumption commitments, enterprise licensing, AI and data arrangements, and global technology services.

  • Develop commercial structures that improve scalability, flexibility, accountability, and value, including licensing models, consumption commitments, unit-based pricing, ramp schedules, price protections, service levels, and performance measures.

  • Apply spend, demand, utilization, benchmark, and supplier-market analyses to identify consolidation, competitive sourcing, license optimization, demand-management, and supplier-rationalization opportunities across the portfolio.

  • Coordinate with Legal, Finance, Information Security, Privacy, Compliance, and Technology stakeholders to address contractual, regulatory, cybersecurity, and third-party risks without compromising speed or business continuity.

  • Represent Procurement as a strategic advisor to Technology & Product leadership while advancing enterprise-wide procurement standards, tools, and ways of working.

What You'll Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Supply Chain, Information Systems, or a related field.

  • 10+ years of experience in strategic sourcing, category management, procurement, vendor management, or a related commercial function, including significant responsibility for technology or product categories.

  • Demonstrated experience leading teams and developing Procurement professionals in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

  • Deep knowledge of technology commercial models, including SaaS and enterprise licensing, cloud and consumption-based pricing, data, AI, infrastructure, hardware, telecom, cybersecurity, and professional services.

  • Proven success leading high-value, complex negotiations and building category strategies for business-critical technology suppliers.

  • Strong financial and analytical acumen, including experience with total cost of ownership, demand and utilization data, benchmarking, and unit economics.

  • Ability to translate technology roadmaps, architecture considerations, and business requirements into practical sourcing and supplier strategies.

  • Strong executive presence with the ability to influence and build credibility with Vice President, Senior Vice President, and C-suite stakeholders.

  • Experience leveraging analytics, AI, automation, and procurement technology to improve sourcing outcomes, controls, and stakeholder experience.

  • Experience in sports betting, iGaming, fantasy sports, technology, financial services, or another regulated industry is a plus.

Join Our Team

We’re a publicly traded (NASDAQ: DKNG) technology company headquartered in Boston. jobs.excerpt: Robots & Pencils is an applied AI engineering firm building the next frontier of business architecture.
jobs.description:
Robots & Pencils is an applied AI engineering firm building the next frontier of business architecture. We design and ship AI co-workers that integrate into enterprise operations and deliver measurable results for our clients. We're all in on AWS, combining deep UX capability with senior engineering talent to get AI into production fast and keep it there.
We’ve earned the trust of leaders across Consumer Products and Retail, Education, Energy, Financial Services, Healthcare, and Manufacturing and more, and earned a reputation as the nimble alternative to traditional global systems integrators. Founded in 2009, with delivery centers in Canada, the United States, Eastern Europe, and Latin America, we are smaller, faster, and more senior by design. Our teams average 15+ years of experience. We move fast, sweat the details, and build things that actually ship.

Position Overview

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager, AI to lead end-to-end product delivery for complex GenAI and agentic AI engagements. This role demands deep AI fluency, hands-on prototyping ability, and the product judgment to navigate non-deterministic systems at enterprise scale. It is ideal for an experienced AI product leader who can own the full arc of an engagement — from framing the problem through shipping a production-grade agentic solution — while building trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders.

In this role, you will work as the primary product lead on a cross-functional AI delivery team, owning the roadmap, defining agent behavior, running evals, and guiding delivery from discovery through phased rollout. You'll bring the technical depth to engage meaningfully with engineering on architecture decisions and the communication skills to frame AI tradeoffs clearly for executive audiences.

Why This Role Matters

At Robots & Pencils, we design AI systems for a human world. Our name says it all. Robots and pencils means engineering paired with creativity, because every agent we ship has to work for real people in real workflows. That balance is baked into how we operate.

Every role here contributes directly to that mission. Here, you shape how AI systems integrate into enterprise operations, how teams move at real velocity, and how products create measurable impact for clients and the people they serve. We ship production-ready AI in 30 to 45 days. That pace demands people who take ownership, lead with craft, and care deeply about what they put their name on.

What You’ll Do

Craft & Delivery

  • Own end-to-end product delivery for complex AI and agentic AI engagements, from discovery and hypothesis framing through phased rollout and production readiness
  • Define and maintain AI product roadmaps that connect agent capabilities to measurable enterprise business outcomes
  • Lead discovery activities including user research, stakeholder interviews, and assumption testing — framing the riskiest hypotheses first and de-risking them before committing to build
  • Design and run experiments including POCs, pilot deployments, and scenario-based testing of multi-step agentic workflows, edge cases, and failure recovery
  • Define agent behavior end-to-end including system prompts, tool schemas, context management, summarization, and working memory patterns across multi-step tasks
  • Own and run evals frameworks covering task completion, reasoning quality, tool selection, failure recovery, and safety — iterating based on evidence rather than assumptions
  • Define success metrics at the agent level including task completion rate, cost per task, escalation rate, and time to resolution alongside business KPIs
  • Establish human-in-the-loop boundaries and guardrails — when the agent acts autonomously, when it escalates, and how to handle non-deterministic output
  • Bring an AI-forward mindset to your daily work, using tools like Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot — and agentic frameworks where relevant — to move faster than traditional product

Collaboration & Communication

  • Lead stakeholder working sessions, prioritization discussions, and risk conversations with senior client stakeholders with confidence and clarity
  • Communicate complex AI tradeoffs, agent behavior, and product decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical executive audiences
  • Build trusted relationships with client stakeholders and serve as a reliable, consultative partner throughout the engagement

Leadership & Influence

  • Lead prioritization decisions by balancing business value, technical feasibility, cost, latency, and delivery timelines
  • Frame every request in terms of user and business outcomes, pushing back on feature-level thinking and managing AI hype cycles with realistic expectations
  • Begin mentoring junior AI PMs on the engagement, sharing knowledge on evals, agent design, and AI product delivery practices

What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in product management with hands-on experience shipping AI features or products
  • Experience working with ERP/EAM systems and data platforms (SAP and Snowflake)
  • Ability to read code (Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript), evaluate architecture decisions, and make informed product tradeoffs on technical constraints
  • Deep understanding of AI concepts including LLMs, RAG, fine-tuning, prompt and context engineering, agentic systems such as planning, tool use, human-in-the-loop controls, and guardrails, and evals
  • Proven ability to prototype AI and agentic solutions using modern AI tools to validate hypotheses and de-risk product decisions (e.g., Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot)
  • Experience delivering AI products in risk-averse, highly regulated, or safety-critical enterprise environments
  • Experience running evals for AI systems and iterating based on results
  • Experience defining agent behavior including system prompts, tool schemas, and human-in-the-loop boundaries
  • Strong experience working with AWS AI services in a product context (e.g., Bedrock, Lambda, SageMaker, Kendra)
  • Strong client communication skills and the ability to frame AI capabilities and limitations for non-technical executive audiences
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where the AI landscape evolves rapidly
  • Experience in a consulting or agency environment, familiarity with agent orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, AWS Strands), or a software engineering background (Python, JavaScript, TypeScript) is a plus

Helpful Extras and Unique Skills

You’ll Do Well Here if You Are

  • A doer. You see something broken and fix it. You'd rather move on clarity than wait for certainty.
  • A fast learner who knows you don't know everything. The AI landscape changes weekly. You're senior enough to know better and curious enough to keep learning anyway.
  • Direct in a way that makes the work better. You give honest feedback. You'd rather have the hard conversation than blow smoke.
  • Obsessed with craft. You know genius is in the details. You ship exceptional, not perfect, and you don't put your name on work you wouldn't stand behind.
  • Built for ownership. You honor commitments, admit mistakes fast, and back your teammates when a decision costs something. No handoffs, no finger-pointing.
  • All in. You treat clients' businesses like your own. You take the work seriously without taking yourself seriously.
  • Resourceful when the budget, timeline, or team is tight. Constraints don't slow you down. They sharpen you.
  • Glad to be in the room with people who care as much as you do. Our teams average fifteen-plus years of experience. We hire people who push each other to do better work.

This range may be modified in the future. Machine Learning (AI Analyst)

We are seeking a Machine Learning Machine Learning (AI Analyst) to support the design and development of analytical data products and services that enable better leverage of data assets and implementation of the Data Strategy. This role is critical to ensuring high-quality data modeling, algorithm development, de-identification, synthetic data creation, visualizations, and evidence development for use across government ministries and external stakeholders. The successful candidate will be an expert who plays a fundamental role in enacting the pillars of the Data Strategy by using data to benefit the public through a coordinated, one-government approach to data governance and service delivery.

The Machine Learning Machine Learning (AI Analyst) will provide hands-on support, leadership, advice, and direction on strategic data initiatives. Key responsibilities include coordinating with internal and external clients to understand analytics needs, creating tools and models that apply artificial intelligence to improve government policy and services, and working with cross-functional project teams to apply machine learning. The role encompasses machine learning model development, artificial intelligence, data analysis, data science, data engineering, data modeling, statistical analysis, and data product design and delivery. - 6 years of experience with and understanding of different approaches and methods for data analytics and data science, such as complex statistical modeling

- 5 years of experience in understanding complex business questions and framing the right analytical question to solve a business problem
